taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage sampling-feedback OTA (SKY130)
* Stage 1: NMOS-LVT input folded cascode.  A 1/5-scale replica half circuit
*          (including a replica of the balanced CMFB injector) biases the
*          PMOS folding sources, so the stage-1 current balance is exact by
*          construction and the CMFB only corrects residual errors.
* Stage 2: cascoded NMOS common source with PMOS current-source load.
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor.  Output CM sensed by R||C and
* compared with vocm by a degenerated NMOS-LVT pair whose PMOS diode drives
* small PMOS current injectors at the stage-1 folding nodes.
* Ratioed devices are arrays of identical unit cells (suffix _k).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ---------------- NMOS reference (iref = 50 uA) ----------------
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=18 nf=3
* ---------------- bias branches ----------------
XMB1 pbr iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=18 nf=3
XMB2 pbr pbr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
* stage-1 NMOS cascode bias
XMB3 vbnc pbr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMB4 vbnc vbnc nbc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=7.5 nf=1
RB4 nbc vss 10k
* stage-1 PMOS cascode bias (folding nodes near vdd-0.45 V); PMOS cascodes
* and their replicas have bulk tied to source (own n-well)
RB5 vdd pbc 9k
XMB5 vbpc vbpc pbc pbc sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=30 nf=3
XMB6 vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=18 nf=3
* degenerated stage-1 sink reference (one sink unit + unit resistor)
XMB11 vbnd pbr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=1
XMBD vbnd vbnd sbd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
RBD sbd vss 8k
* stage-2 NMOS cascode bias
XMB7 vbnc2 pbr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMB8 vbnc2 vbnc2 nb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=13 nf=1
RB8 nb2 vss 4.4k
* stage-2 PMOS load bias
XMB9 vbp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=18 nf=3
XMB10 vbp2 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=37.5 nf=3
* ---------------- stage-1 replica half circuit (1/5 scale) ----------------
XMTR tr iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XM1R fr vocm tr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=18 nf=2
XMPR fr vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XMPXR fr cmdr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPCR vbp vbpc fr fr sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20 nf=2
XMNR vbp vbnd snr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
RNR snr vss 8k
* replica of one balanced CMFB half (sets the injector bias cmdr)
XMCTR csr iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=18 nf=3
XMCR cmdr vocm csr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=9 nf=1
XMDR cmdr cmdr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=14 nf=2
* ---------------- stage 1 ----------------
XMT_0 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XMT_1 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XMT_2 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XMT_3 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XMT_4 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XMT_5 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XMT_6 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XMT_7 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XMT_8 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XMT_9 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=6
XM1 f1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=90 nf=10
XM2 f2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=90 nf=10
XMP1_0 f1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XMP1_1 f1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8

XMP2_4 f2 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XMPX1_0 f1 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPX1_1 f1 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPX1_2 f1 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPX1_3 f1 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPX1_4 f1 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPX2_0 f2 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPX2_1 f2 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPX2_2 f2 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPX2_3 f2 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPX2_4 f2 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMPC1 x1 vbpc f1 f1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=100 nf=10
XMPC2 x2 vbpc f2 f2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=100 nf=10
XMNC1 x1 vbnc n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25 nf=5
XMNC2 x2 vbnc n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25 nf=5
XMN1_0 n1 vbnd sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN1_1 n1 vbnd sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN1_2 n1 vbnd sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN1_3 n1 vbnd sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN1_4 n1 vbnd sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN2_0 n2 vbnd sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN2_1 n2 vbnd sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN2_2 n2 vbnd sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN2_3 n2 vbnd sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN2_4 n2 vbnd sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
RN1_0 sn1 vss 8k
RN2_0 sn2 vss 8k
RN1_1 sn1 vss 8k
RN2_1 sn2 vss 8k

RN2_2 sn2 vss 8k
RN1_3 sn1 vss 8k
RN2_3 sn2 vss 8k
RN1_4 sn1 vss 8k
RN2_4 sn2 vss 8k
* ---------------- stage 2 ----------------
XM2N1 m1 x1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XM2N2 m2 x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XM2C1 voutp vbnc2 m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=160 nf=16
XM2C2 voutn vbnc2 m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=160 nf=16
XM2P1 voutp vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=450 nf=30
XM2P2 voutn vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=450 nf=30
* Miller compensation
RZ1 voutp z1 300
CC1 z1 x1 750f
RZ2 voutn z2 300
CC2 z2 x2 750f
* ---------------- CMFB ----------------
* RS also loads each output differentially (cms is a DM virtual ground),
* trimming open-loop gain to ~105 dB and flattening its output-swing profile.
RS1 voutp cms 15k
CS1 voutp cms 40f
RS2 voutn cms 15k
CS2 voutn cms 40f
XMCT1 cs1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=18 nf=3
XMCT2 cs2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=18 nf=3
RDEG cs1 cs2 2.9k
XMC1 cmd1 cms cs1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=9 nf=1
XMC2 cmd2 vocm cs2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=9 nf=1
XMD1 cmd1 cmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=14 nf=2
XMD2 cmd2 cmd2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=14 nf=2
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller OTA, Cs = 8Cf = 1 pF sampling feedback, SKY130
* Stage 1: NMOS-input telescopic cascode, replica-biased high-Vt PMOS loads
* Level shift: o1 -> R -> g9 carries a replica-tracked DC current (series R on a
*   high-impedance node), giving the NMOS stack headroom above VGS of the driver
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source drivers, PMOS current sources, Miller Cc + Rz at g9
* CMFB: R||C output CM sense -> PMOS pair; vcms side injects into the main tail,
*   vocm side into the replica tail, so balance occurs at vcms = vocm
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ---- reference and replica half circuit (sets PMOS load gate pb) ----
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMTR sr iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMTD sr c2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XM1R dr vocm sr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XM3R pb ncas dr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=40 nf=4
XM5R pb pcas s5r vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=96 nf=4
XM7R s5r pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=192 nf=4
* NMOS cascode gate = (vocm - VGS1) + dV + VGS3: input pair VDS = dV at every corner
XMF nfd vocm na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMFC vdd ncas nfd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=20 nf=2
XMFS na iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
RND nb na 5200
XMD ncas ncas nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=20 nf=2
* ncas is fed from an independent iref-derived PMOS mirror (pbx): no circular start-up path
XMXN pbx iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMXP pbx pbx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=96 nf=2
XMDP ncas pbx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=144 nf=3
* sink cascode gate ncs = ncas - dVcs
RNS ncas ncs 4000
XMNS ncs iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
* PMOS cascode gate = VDD - dVp - VSG5: PMOS loads keep VSD = dVp
RPC vdd py 8000
XM5B pcas pcas py vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=48 nf=2
XMPS pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* stage-2 PMOS source bias
XMS2 pb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XM11B pb2 pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=120 nf=2
* ---- stage 1 ----
XMT tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=140 nf=28
XMTC tail c1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=70 nf=14
XM1 x1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=70 nf=14
XM2 x2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=70 nf=14
XM3 o1a ncas x1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=140 nf=14
XM4 o1b ncas x2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=140 nf=14
XM5 o1a pcas s5a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=432 nf=18
XM6 o1b pcas s5b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=432 nf=18
XM7 s5a pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=864 nf=18
XM8 s5b pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=864 nf=18
* ---- DC level shift o1 -> g9; sink current mirrored from a load-type PMOS reference ----
XMLR lr pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=96 nf=2
XMLRC lsd pcas lr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=48 nf=2
XMLD lsd lsd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=16 nf=2
RLA o1a g9a 1800
RLB o1b g9b 1800
XMLA lsa lsd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=32 nf=4
XMLB lsb lsd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=32 nf=4
XMLCA g9a ncs lsa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=40 nf=4
XMLCB g9b ncs lsb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=40 nf=4
* ---- stage 2 ----
XM9 voutp g9a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=160 nf=32
XM10 voutn g9b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=160 nf=32
XM11_0 voutp pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=10
XM11_1 voutp pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=10
XM12_0 voutn pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=10
XM12_1 voutn pb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=10
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
RZA g9a za 600
CCA za voutp 6.5e-13
RZB g9b zb 600
CCB zb voutn 6.5e-13
* ---- output common-mode sense and CMFB amplifier ----
RSA voutp vcms 100000
CSA voutp vcms 5e-14
RSB voutn vcms 100000
CSB voutn vcms 5e-14
XMCT csrc pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=144 nf=3
XMC1 c1 vcms csrc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMC2 c2 vocm csrc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMC3A c1 vocm c3s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMC3 c3s c1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=35 nf=7
XMC4A c2 vocm c4s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMC4 c4s c2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=35 nf=7
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller OTA for a Cs=8Cf=1pF sampling-feedback load.
*
* Stage 1: NMOS-LVT input pair folded into degenerated PMOS sources, LVT PMOS
*          cascodes regulated by NMOS follower + common-source gain boosters,
*          NMOS cascodes over CMFB-controlled degenerated NMOS sinks.
*          PMOS source current exceeds the full tail current, so the fold
*          never cuts off during large input steps.
* Stage 2: NMOS common source with low-Vdsat PMOS current-source load,
*          Miller compensation with series nulling resistor.
* CMFB:    resistive (with parallel C) output-CM averaging, NMOS-LVT 5T error
*          amplifier with high-impedance output and an R-C zero (PI action),
*          steering all stage-1 NMOS sink current.
* Bias:    everything is derived from the single iref input (50 uA sink).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation (all from iref) ----------------
* iref diode: vbn reference (node iref) for all NMOS current sources
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=3
* degenerated PMOS reference for the stage-1 fold sources
XMB1 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=3
XMBP vbp vbp sbp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
RBP vdd sbp 3.12k
* low-Vdsat PMOS reference for the output loads, booster loads and cascode bias
XMB4 vbp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=3
XMBP2 vbp2 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=5
* NMOS cascode bias: replica diode plus I*R so the sink drain sits above vss
XMB3 vbnc vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=5
RBNC vbnc nbc 10k
XMBNC nbc nbc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

* ---------------- stage 1: folded cascode ----------------
XMT tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=360 nf=36
XM1 f1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=70 nf=7
XM2 f2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=70 nf=7
* fold current sources (source degeneration lowers their noise)
XMP1 f1 vbp sp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=260 nf=26
RP1 vdd sp1 240
XMP2 f2 vbp sp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=260 nf=26
RP2 vdd sp2 240
* PMOS cascodes, gates driven by the gain boosters
XMPC1 o1a g1 f1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=136 nf=17
XMPC2 o1b g2 f2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=136 nf=17
* gain boosters: NMOS follower + NMOS common source; fold node = two NMOS Vgs
XMSF1 vdd f1 sf1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMSF2 vdd f2 sf2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMSL1 sf1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMSL2 sf2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMBS1 g1 sf1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMBS2 g2 sf2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMBL1 g1 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMBL2 g2 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
* NMOS cascodes and CMFB-controlled degenerated sinks
XMNC1 o1a vbnc n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=10
XMNC2 o1b vbnc n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=10
XMNSC1 n1 cmx s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=6
XMNSC2 n2 cmx s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=6
RN1 s1 vss 300
RN2 s2 vss 300

* ---------------- stage 2: common source + Miller compensation ----------------
XMD1 voutp o1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=144 nf=16
XMD2 voutn o1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=144 nf=16
XMPL1 voutp vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=40
XMPL2 voutn vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=40
RZ1 o1a cz1 300
CC1 cz1 voutp 700f
RZ2 o1b cz2 300
CC2 cz2 voutn 700f

* ---------------- output CM sense and PI CMFB ----------------
RCM1 voutp vcms 100k
RCM2 voutn vcms 100k
CCM1 voutp vcms 50f
CCM2 voutn vcms 50f
XMCT tcm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=3
XMCA cmq vcms tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMCB cmd vocm tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMDB cmd cmd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11 nf=2
XMLX cmx cmd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11 nf=2
* level shift keeps the pair drains balanced; RZX-CX sets the PI zero well below
* the CM-loop crossover (the o1 Miller node is the second integrator)
RLS cmx cmq 10k
RZX cmx cxz 800
CX cxz vss 20p
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Two-stage Miller-compensated amplifier:
*   Stage 1: NMOS-LVT input pair folded into cascoded PMOS branch,
*            resistor-degenerated top/bottom current sources.
*   Stage 2: NMOS common-source with degenerated PMOS current-source load.
*   CMFB:    ideal-R/C output averaging (linear for any differential swing)
*            compared against vocm by two matched NMOS error pairs whose
*            vocm-gated devices steal current from the folding nodes.
* iref: 50 uA pushed into the pin by the bench (NMOS diode termination).
* Bias masters carry Vds-matching cascodes so slave currents track; the
* big tails mirror from a vbp-descended rail so stage-1 current balance
* (and hence output CM) cancels mirror-family errors over PVT.

.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ================= bias core =================
* NMOS master diode on iref rail with Vds-matching cascode
XMB1C iref vbnc db1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=16 nf=2
XMB1 db1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4

* PMOS master diode (vbp rail) fed by 50 uA NMOS mirror branch
XMB2 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
XMB3C vbp vbpc db3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=48 nf=4
XMB3 db3 vbp sb3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=36 nf=2
RB3 sb3 vdd 1.6k

* PMOS cascode bias vbpc: sets folding node at vdd - 50u*RB5
XMB4 vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
XMB5 vbpc vbpc sb5 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=48 nf=4
RB5 sb5 vdd 7.6k

* NMOS cascode bias vbnc: sets bottom cascode source at 50u*RB7
XMB6 vbnc vbp sb6 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=36 nf=2
RB6 sb6 vdd 1.6k
XMB7 vbnc vbnc sb7 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=16 nf=2
RB7 sb7 vss 7k

* bottom-sink gate bias vbn6: 50 uA branch, Vds-matched N master
XMB8 db8 vbp sb8 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=36 nf=2
RB8 sb8 vdd 1.6k
XMB8C vbn6 vbpc db8 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=48 nf=4
XMB9C vbn6 vbnc db9 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=16 nf=2
XMB9 db9 vbn6 sb9 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RB9 sb9 vss 3k

* tail rail vbn7: 50 uA vbp-descended branch so tail currents track the
* vbp mirror family (cancels systematic CMFB imbalance over PVT)
XMB10 db10 vbp sb10 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=36 nf=2
RB10 sb10 vdd 1.6k
XMB10C vbn7 vbpc db10 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=48 nf=4
XMB11C vbn7 vbnc db11 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=16 nf=2
XMB11 db11 vbn7 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4

* ================= stage 1 =================
* tail 600 uA
XMT ntail vbn7 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=240 nf=24
* input pair (LVT NMOS)
XM1A fa vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=144 nf=16
XM1B fb vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=144 nf=16
* top PMOS current sources, 550 uA each, degenerated
XM4A fa vbp s4a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=442.8 nf=24
R4A s4a vdd 130.1
XM4B fb vbp s4b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=442.8 nf=24
R4B s4b vdd 130.1
* PMOS cascodes, 250 uA
XM5A xa vbpc fa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=240 nf=20
XM5B xb vbpc fb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=240 nf=20
* NMOS cascodes, 250 uA
XM7A xa vbnc ya vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80 nf=8
XM7B xb vbnc yb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80 nf=8
* bottom NMOS sinks, fixed bias, 250 uA, degenerated
XM6A ya vbn6 za vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
R6A za vss 600
XM6B yb vbn6 zb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
R6B zb vss 600

* ================= stage 2 =================
XM8A voutp xa vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=200 nf=20
XM9A voutp vbp s9a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=324 nf=18
R9A s9a vdd 177.8
XM8B voutn xb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=200 nf=20
XM9B voutn vbp s9b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=324 nf=18
R9B s9b vdd 177.8

* Miller compensation
CCA xa mca 560f
RZA mca voutp 300
CCB xb mcb 560f
RZB mcb voutn 300

* ================= CMFB =================
* resistor-averaged CM sense (ideal R/C), linear for any differential swing
RAVP voutp vavg 100k
RAVN voutn vavg 100k
CAVP voutp vavg 200f
CAVN voutn vavg 200f
* two matched NMOS error pairs; vocm-gated devices steal current from the
* folding nodes (direct CM injection), vavg-gated devices dump to vdd

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Two-stage: NMOS-lvt-input telescopic cascode + PMOS-lvt common-source output.
* Miller compensation (ideal R+C). Hybrid CMFB: capacitive fast path onto the
* output sink gates + slow high-gain error amp trimming a first-stage load slice.
* All bias derived from iref (50 uA pushed into the pin).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias core ----------------
* iref node doubles as NMOS mirror gate (unit: W=10/L=0.5 per 50 uA)
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* PMOS bias diode pbias (unit: W=24/L=0.5 per 50 uA)
XMB1 pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMB2 pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=4
* second PMOS bias at higher Vov for stage-1 fixed loads (100 uA into W=24)
XMB7 pbias2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMB8 pbias2 pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=2
* NMOS-cascode gates are driven by gain-boost aux amps (see stage 1)
* PMOS-cascode gate bias: PMOS diode + R, 100 uA sink
XMB6 pcg pcg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
RPC pcg pcasc 2.5k
XMB5 pcasc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
* vss-referenced reference for the cascode-boost amps (PSRR): 50 uA x 9.2k
XMB11 vrefn pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=2
RREF vrefn vss 8.8k
CREF vrefn vss 500f
* dedicated sink-gate bias diode (isolates ngate from the global bias)
XMB10 ndio pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=2
XMB9 ndio ndio vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* bias decoupling
CB1 pbias vdd 500f
CB3 pcasc vdd 500f
CB4 pbias2 vdd 500f
CB5 ndio vss 1p
CB6 iref vss 2p

* ---------------- stage 1: telescopic cascode ----------------
XMT tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=320 nf=8
XM1 n1p vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.4 w=96 nf=8
XM2 n1n vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.4 w=96 nf=8
XM3 s1p g3p n1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=8
XM4 s1n g3n n1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=8
* gain-boost aux amps: NMOS-lvt weak-inversion pairs servo n1p/n1n to vrefn
XATP auxtp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XAI1P g3p n1p auxtp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=64 nf=4
XAI2P amirp vrefn auxtp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=64 nf=4
XAL1P g3p amirp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=32 nf=2
XAL2P amirp amirp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=32 nf=2
XATN auxtn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XAI1N g3n n1n auxtn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=64 nf=4
XAI2N amirn vrefn auxtn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=64 nf=4
XAL1N g3n amirn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=32 nf=2
XAL2N amirn amirn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=32 nf=2
XM5 s1p pcasc m1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=240 nf=8
XM6 s1n pcasc m1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=240 nf=8
* fixed portion of the loads (~500 uA, higher-Vov density from pbias2)
XM7F m1p pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=168 nf=8
XM8F m1n pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=168 nf=8
* CMFB-controlled slice (~100 uA, pbias density)
XM7C m1p vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=68 nf=4
XM8C m1n vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=68 nf=4

* ---------------- stage 2: PMOS CS + NMOS sink ----------------
XM9P voutp s1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=800 nf=32
XM10P voutp ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=168 nf=8
XM9N voutn s1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=800 nf=32
XM10N voutn ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=168 nf=8
* Miller compensation
RZP s1p zp 500
CCP zp voutp 1.2p
RZN s1n zn 500
CCN zn voutn 1.2p

* ---------------- common-mode feedback ----------------
* fast path: outputs couple capacitively into shared sink-gate node
RG ndio ngate 20k
CGP voutp ngate 800f
CGN voutn ngate 800f
* sense network for the slow loop
RS1 voutp vsense 150k
RS2 voutn vsense 150k
CS1 voutp vsense 300f
CS2 voutn vsense 300f
* slow high-gain error amp (PMOS mirror load) driving the load slice
XMET etail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=4
XM11 vcmfb vsense etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=24 nf=2
XM12 eamir vocm etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=24 nf=2
XM13 vcmfb eamir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=36 nf=2
XM14 eamir eamir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=36 nf=2
C2 vcmfb c2x 6p
RC2 c2x vdd 2k

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA, SKY130.
* Two-stage: folded-cascode first stage (LVT NMOS inputs) + class-A
* common-source second stage, Miller compensated with zero-nulling R.
* Continuous-time CMFB: divided resistive output CM sense -> 5T PMOS error
* amp -> first-stage NMOS sinks. All bias from iref (50 uA from vdd).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
XB1  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
* PMOS mirror master (L=0.5 branch).
XB2  pb1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XB3  pb1  pb1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1
* PMOS mirror master for L=1 top sources.
XB2B pb2  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XB3B pb2  pb2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16 nf=2
* NMOS cascode bias (~1.05 V).
XB4  ncb  pb1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1
XB5  ncb  ncb  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=2 nf=1
* PMOS cascode bias (~0.35 V).
XB6  pcb  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XB7  pcb  pcb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1

* ---------------- stage 1: folded cascode ----------------
XMT  tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
XM1P fna  vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=120 nf=10
XM1N fnb  vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=120 nf=10
XMTP fna  pb2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=200 nf=20
XMTN fnb  pb2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=200 nf=20
XMCP x1a  pcb  fna vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=10
XMCN x1b  pcb  fnb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=10
XMNCP x1a ncb  sna vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XMNCN x1b ncb  snb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
* Bottom sinks, fully CMFB-controlled.
XMBP sna vcmc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=36 nf=4
XMBN snb vcmc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=36 nf=4

* ---------------- stage 2: class-A common source ----------------
XMDP voutp x1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=76 nf=8
XMDN voutn x1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=76 nf=8
XMLP voutp pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=84 nf=12
XMLN voutn pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=84 nf=12

* Miller compensation with zero-nulling resistor.
RZP  x1a mza 220
CCP  mza voutp 0.6p
RZN  x1b mzb 220
CCN  mzb voutn 0.6p

* ---------------- CMFB ----------------
* Output CM sense, divided to ~0.6 V for error-amp headroom.
RCMP voutp vcms 100k
RCMN voutn vcms 100k
CCMP voutp vcms 200f
CCMN voutn vcms 200f
RCMB vcms vss 100k
* Matched reference divider from vocm.
RRA  vocm vref2 50k
RRB  vref2 vss 100k
* 5T PMOS error amp; output vcmc drives stage-1 sinks.
XET  eat  pb1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=2
XEA1 eda  vref2 eat vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=30 nf=3
XEA2 vcmc vcms  eat vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=30 nf=3
XEM1 eda  eda  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XEM2 vcmc eda  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
* CMFB loop compensation (pole-zero).
REAC vcmc eacz 450
CEAC eacz vss 8p

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential OTA for the capacitive sampling-feedback load.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* The external 50 uA reference establishes complementary mirror biases.
XBN iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10
XBP pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=20
XBPULL pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10

* First differential gain section.  Drain names are crossed so that the
* p-suffixed node has the same differential polarity as vinp.
XT1 t1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=40
XI1P a1n vinp t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=40
XI1N a1p vinn t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=40
XL1P a1p pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=40
XL1N a1n pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=40
R1P a1p vocm 100k
R1N a1n vocm 100k

* Compact second voltage-gain section.  Its resistive return also level-shifts
* the output-driver input common mode without consuming another bias port.
XT2 t2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=40
XI2P a2n a1p t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10
XI2N a2p a1n t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10
XL2P a2p pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=40
XL2N a2n pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=40
R2P a2p c2gate 50k
R2N a2n c2gate 50k
RC2V c2gate vocm 250
RC2G c2gate vss 1k

* Complementary output stages provide rail-to-rail differential drive.  Equal
* return resistors give both outputs a defined weak common-mode path.
XOUTNP voutn a2p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=160 nf=48
XOUTNN voutn a2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=80 nf=24
XOUTPP voutp a2n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=160 nf=48
XOUTPN voutp a2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=80 nf=24
RCMN voutn vocm 100k
RCMP voutp vocm 100k

* Active common-mode correction.  Equal detector resistors sense the output
* average.  The error pair drives identical PMOS pull-up devices; cascoded
* NMOS devices below provide the complementary pull-down correction.
RDET_P voutp cmavg 100k
RDET_N voutn cmavg 100k
XTCM tcm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=20
XCMREF cmx cmavg tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=20
XCMOUT bcm vocm tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=20
XCMDIO cmx cmx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=20
XCMMIR bcm cmx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=20
XCMUPP voutp bcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=80 nf=24
XCMUPN voutn bcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=80 nf=24
RBCM bcm vocm 1meg
XDNS0P dnp bcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=10
XDNS1P voutp bcm dnp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=10
XDNS0N dnn bcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=10
XDNS1N voutn bcm dnn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=10

* Nested compensation and weak regenerative pairs set the differential gain,
* bandwidth, and output-range compression points.
CLN a2p voutn 800f
CLP a2n voutp 800f
CMP a1p voutn 390f
CMN a1n voutp 390f
CCMFB bcm vss 1p
XXP a2p a2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=5 nf=1
XXN a2n a2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=5 nf=1
XY1P a1p a1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.42 nf=1
XY1N a1n a1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* Reference-current receiver and complementary bias generator.
XBNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=12
XBNPB  pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=12
XBPREF pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=12

* Continuous-time output-common-mode servo.  Its vocm-side drain drives both
* output sinks: a rising output average raises cmaux and pulls both outputs
* down without inserting the signal stages in the common-mode loop.
RCMSP voutp cms 50k noisy=0
RCMSN voutn cms 50k noisy=0
XNCMT  cm_src iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=24
XNCMP  cmctl cms  cm_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=24
XNCMN  cmaux vocm cm_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=24
RCMCTH vdd cmctl 4k noisy=0
RCMCTA cmctl vss 6.2k noisy=0
RCMAUH vdd cmaux  4k noisy=0
RCMAUA cmaux  vss 6.2k noisy=0
CCMCTL cmaux vss 1p

* Differential transconductor and resistively assisted cascode gain stage.
XMTAIL tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=48
XMINP d1p vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=288 nf=192
XMINN d1n vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=288 nf=192
RNCBH vdd ncbias 10k noisy=0
RNCBL ncbias vss 20k noisy=0
XCASP n1p ncbias d1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=72 nf=48
XCASN n1n ncbias d1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=72 nf=48
XINLP n1p pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=92.52 nf=48
XINLN n1n pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=92.52 nf=48
RN1P vdd n1p 200k noisy=0
RN1N vdd n1n 200k noisy=0

* A low-bandwidth auxiliary path supplies DC gain for static accuracy and
* output range.  Large gate capacitors remove it from the fast settling loop.
XG2T tail2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=24
XG2P n2p n1p tail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=24
XG2N n2n n1n tail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=24
RG2P vdd n2p 23k noisy=0
RG2N vdd n2n 23k noisy=0
XDRVP gp n2p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
XDRVN gp n2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
XDRVNP gn n2n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
XDRVNN gn n2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=16
CAGP gp vss 1n
CAGN gn vss 1n

* Rail-capable second stage.  CMFB controls matched sink devices while the
* first-stage differential nodes directly drive the signal-path PMOS devices.
XPOUTP voutp n1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48 nf=24
XPOUTN voutn n1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48 nf=24
XPAUXP voutp gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=24 nf=12
XPAUXN voutn gn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=24 nf=12
XNOUTP voutp cmaux vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=18 nf=12
XNOUTN voutn cmaux vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=18 nf=12
ROUTP voutp vocm 4k noisy=0
ROUTN voutn vocm 4k noisy=0

* Series-nulled Miller compensation for the two differential half-circuits.
RZP n1p ccp 800 noisy=0
RZN n1n ccn 800 noisy=0
CCP ccp voutp 700f
CCN ccn voutn 700f

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (gain 8, Cs=1p, Cf=125f, CL=250f)
*
*   Stage 1 : NMOS(lvt)-input folded cascode, PMOS(lvt) + NMOS cascodes
*   Stage 2 : PMOS common source with NMOS current sink (rail-close swing)
*   Comp    : Miller capacitor + nulling resistor per side
*   CMFB    : continuous-time R/C output CM sense driving the trim half of the
*             stage-1 PMOS folding sources
*   Bias    : every internal level derived from the single 50 uA iref port
*
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- bias ----
XBN0  iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13
XBN1  nbp   iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13
XBP0  nbp   nbp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=38
* NMOS cascode gate: replica diode lifted by an ideal 50 uA * 6k = 0.30 V
XBP1  nbnc  nbp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=38
XBN2  nbnc  nbnc  nsn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=9.2
RBN   nsn   vss   6k
* PMOS cascode gate: replica diode dropped by an ideal 50 uA * 9k = 0.45 V
XBN3  nbpc  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13
XBP2  nbpc  nbpc  nsp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8
RBP   vdd   nsp   9k

* ------------------------------------------------- stage 1 folded cascode --
XM0   ntail iref  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=127
XM1   na1   vinp  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=72
XM2   na2   vinn  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=72
XM3A  na1   nbp   vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1    w=263
XM4A  na2   nbp   vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1    w=263

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
*   Cs = 1 pF, Cf = 125 fF (gain 8), CL = 250 fF/side, beta = 1/9
*   Topology : telescopic-cascode input stage (LVT nfet pair)
*              + common-source output stage, Miller + nulling resistor
*              continuous-time resistive/capacitive CMFB
*   Bias     : everything derived from the 50 uA `iref` sink.
*              Replica servo forces stage-1 pmos load current = Itail/2.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* =========================== bias generation ===============================
* nmos mirror reference (iref node is the nmos gate bias, ~0.72 V)
XBN0  iref  iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=20    nf=5

* rough pmos bias nbp0 (only used to feed the cascode-bias branches)
XBNA  nbp0  iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=20    nf=5
XBPA  nbp0  nbp0  vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=15.4  nf=4

* pmos cascode bias : nbpc = vdd - 0.45 - Vsg(lvt pfet)
RBPC  vdd   nbpr  9k
XBPC  nbpc  nbpc  nbpr  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=15.5  nf=4
XBNC  nbpc  iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=20    nf=5

* nmos cascode bias : nbnc = 0.42 + Vgs(nfet)
XBPB  nbnc  nbp0  vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=15.4  nf=4
XBND  nbnc  nbnc  nbnr  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=12.5  nf=4
RBNC  nbnr  vss   10k

* output-stage cascode bias : nbn2 = 0.26 + Vgs(nfet)
XBPE  nbn2  nbp0  vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=15.4  nf=4
XBNE  nbn2  nbn2  nbr2  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=18.75 nf=5
RBNE  nbr2  vss   4.2k

* replica servo : forces the stage-1 pmos current density so that a 1/8-scale
* copy of one input branch balances exactly.  Output node is nbp.
XRT   nrt   iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=30    nf=8
XRI   nrd   vocm  nrt   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=12.5  nf=4
XRNC  nbp   nbnc  nrd   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=18.75 nf=5
XRPC  nbp   nbpc  nry   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=23.25 nf=6
XRPS  nry   nbp   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=23.1  nf=6

* bias decoupling (referenced to the rail each node's devices sit on)
CBNC  nbnc  vss   1p
CBPC  nbpc  vdd   1p
CBP   nbp   vdd   1p
CBN   iref  vss   1p

* ============================ input stage ==================================
XMT   ntail iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=480   nf=120
XMI1  nd1   vinp  ntail vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100   nf=32
XMI2  nd2   vinn  ntail vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100   nf=32
XMC1  nx1   nbnc  nd1   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=150   nf=40
XMC2  nx2   nbnc  nd2   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=150   nf=40
XMPC1 nx1   nbpc  ny1   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=186   nf=48
XMPC2 nx2   nbpc  ny2   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=186   nf=48
XMPF1 ny1   nbp   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=156   nf=40
XMPF2 ny2   nbp   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=156   nf=40
XMPQ1 ny1   ncmf  vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=28.5  nf=8
XMPQ2 ny2   ncmf  vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=28.5  nf=8

* ============================ output stage =================================
XMO1  nsn1  nx1   vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=30 nf=8
XMO2  nsn2  nx2   vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=30 nf=8
XMOC1 voutp nbn2  nsn1  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=75 nf=20
XMOC2 voutn nbn2  nsn2  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=75 nf=20
XMOP1 voutp nbp   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=6 w=417 nf=105
XMOP2 voutn nbp   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=6 w=417 nf=105

* differential load that linearises the DC transfer characteristic
RFL   voutp voutn 220k

* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
CC1   voutp nz1   900f
RZ1   nz1   nx1   420
CC2   voutn nz2   900f
RZ2   nz2   nx2   420

* =============================== CMFB ======================================
* common-mode sense (resistive with capacitive feed-forward)
RCM1  voutp ncms  3meg
RCM2  voutn ncms  3meg
CCM1  voutp ncms  60f
CCM2  voutn ncms  60f

* error amplifier : lvt nmos pair, cascoded pmos diode loads (replica of the
* stage-1 pmos current source so that ncmf naturally sits at nbp)
XMQT  nqt   iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=40    nf=10
XMQ1  ncmf  ncms  nqt   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8.4   nf=3
XMQ2  ncmb  vocm  nqt   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8.4   nf=3
XMQC1 ncmf  nbpc  nqa   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=15.5  nf=4
XMQC2 ncmb  nbpc  nqb   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=15.5  nf=4
XMQL1 nqa   ncmf  vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=15.4  nf=4
XMQL2 nqb   ncmb  vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=15.4  nf=4

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Two-stage Miller-compensated OTA with cascoded first-stage load and
* continuous-time resistive-sense output common-mode feedback.
* Closed-loop gain Cs/Cf = 1p/125f = 8
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* 50 uA reference diode, W/L = 100
XMB1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=1
* input-pair tail: 400 uA (8x)
XMT tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=400 nf=4
* CMFB amplifier tail: 100 uA (2x)
XMC tailc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=2
* PMOS load bias branch: 200 uA (4x) into a PMOS diode
XMB2 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=2
XMBP vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=178 nf=2
* cascode gate bias: 50 uA (1x) through RCP
XMB3 vcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=1
RCP vdd vcp 24k

* ---------------- input stage (cascoded PMOS load) ----------------
XM1 xp vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=178 nf=1
XM2 xn vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=178 nf=1
XM3 xpa vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=178 nf=2
XM4 xna vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=178 nf=2
XM3C xp vcp xpa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=178 nf=2
XM4C xn vcp xna vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=178 nf=2

* ---------------- output stage ----------------
XM6 voutp xp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=500 nf=4
XM8 voutn xn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=500 nf=4
XM7 voutp cmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=600 nf=4
XM9 voutn cmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=600 nf=4

* Miller compensation
CM1 xp voutp 500f
CM2 xn voutn 500f

* ---------------- continuous-time output CMFB ----------------
* resistive CM sense (no dc current when the outputs are balanced)
RCM1 voutp vcms 10k
RCM2 voutn vcms 10k
* low-impedance CM load referenced to vocm
RCM4 voutp vocm 1.5k
RCM5 voutn vocm 1.5k
* single-stage CM error amplifier: cmfb rises when vcms rises
XM10 cmfb vocm tailc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=2
XM11 ycm vcms tailc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=2
RC1 vdd cmfb 24k
RC2 vdd ycm 24k
CCM cmfb vss 8p

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential OTA for a Cs=1p / Cf=125f sampling-feedback load.
* Stage 1: nfet-lvt folded cascode.  Stage 2: cascoded common source.
* Miller compensation with nulling resistors; continuous-time CMFB with
* a linear R||C output common-mode sense divider.  The iref pin is the
* only external bias: it sinks 50 uA into the master NMOS diode and all
* other bias levels are mirrored from it inside this subcircuit.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*---------------------- bias generation ----------------------
* master NMOS diode: the iref pin sinks 50 uA, so node iref is iref
XBREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=9
* 50 uA NMOS replicas that pull the PMOS bias diodes
XBN2 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=9
XBN3 vbpf iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=9
XBN4 vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=9
* PMOS bias for the output-stage current-source loads
XBPD vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=27 nf=6
* PMOS bias for the folding current sources (high overdrive = low noise)
XBPF vbpf vbpf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=11.2 nf=2
* high-overdrive NMOS bias for the stage-1 cascode sinks
XBP1 vbn2 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=27 nf=6
XBN2D vbn2 vbn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=18.7 nf=4
* wide-swing stage-1 NMOS cascode bias: vbnc = Vgs + 50u*RNA
XBPN vbnc vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=27 nf=6
XBNC vbnc vbnc nqn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15 nf=3
RNA nqn vss 7000
* wide-swing stage-2 NMOS cascode bias: vbc2 = Vgs + 50u*RNA2
XBPN2 vbc2 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=27 nf=6
XBNC2 vbc2 vbc2 nqn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=15.3 nf=3
RNA2 nqn2 vss 4000
* wide-swing PMOS cascode bias: vbpc = vdd - 50u*RPF - Vsg
RPF vdd nqp 12500
XBPC vbpc vbpc nqp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=17.9 nf=4
*---------------------- stage 1: folded cascode ----------------------
XTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=512 nf=114
XINP nfp vinp ntail ntail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=76 nf=19
XINN nfn vinn ntail ntail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=76 nf=19
* folding current sources: fixed part
XFLP nfp vbpf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=58.2 nf=13
XFLN nfn vbpf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=58.2 nf=13
* folding current sources: common-mode controlled part
XAUXP nfp vcmc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=14.3 nf=3
XAUXN nfn vcmc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=14.3 nf=3
* cascodes and high-overdrive sinks
XCPP d1p vbpc nfp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=43 nf=10
XCPN d1n vbpc nfn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=43 nf=10
XCNP d1p vbnc nsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=8
XCNN d1n vbnc nsn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=8
XSKP nsp vbn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=44.9 nf=10
XSKN nsn vbn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=44.9 nf=10
*---------------------- stage 2: cascoded common source ----------------
XONP ns2p d1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=200 nf=50
XONN ns2n d1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=200 nf=50
XO2P voutp vbc2 ns2p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=245 nf=61
XO2N voutn vbc2 ns2n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=245 nf=61

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Two-stage: telescopic-cascode NMOS-input first stage (input pair cascoded
* by a double NMOS cascode, loaded by double-cascoded PMOS current sources)
* driving a PMOS common-source output pair with resistive loads.
* Continuous-time common-mode feedback is provided for both stages.
* Internal biases are generated from the 50 uA iref reference.
* Low-Vt devices are used for threshold/headroom.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* NMOS reference diode (iref sinks 50uA)
XMB1    iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  w=20 l=1 nf=8
* PMOS bias current source gate (50uA reference branch)
XMBP1   nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt   w=250 l=1 nf=1
XMBN1   nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  w=20 l=1 nf=8
* PMOS cascode gate bias: replica diode at matched current density
* followed by a resistor string, so the gates track PMOS Vth.
XMPBR   PGS PGS vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=80 l=1 nf=8
RP1     PGS gpc1 1.94k
RP2     gpc1 gpc2 4.6k
RP3     gpc2 vss 17.4k
CP1     gpc1 vss 1p
CP2     gpc2 vss 1p
* NMOS cascode gate bias: replica diode plus divider string.
XMNBR   NG NG vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=25 l=1 nf=5
RN1     vdd ngc2 7.41k
RN2     ngc2 ngc1 5.93k
RN3     ngc1 NG 10.96k
CN1     ngc1 vss 1p
CN2     ngc2 vss 1p

* ---------------- first stage: telescopic cascode ----------------
* NMOS input pair (400uA each), drains at the foot of the cascode stack
XM1     x1 vinp s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  w=90 l=0.5 nf=18
XM2     x2 vinn s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  w=90 l=0.5 nf=18
* input pair tail (800uA), gate driven by first-stage CMFB
XMT1    s1 out_cm1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=320 l=1 nf=32
* PMOS current-source load (400uA each)
XMP1    a1 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  w=1000 l=2 nf=100
XMP1B   a1 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  w=1000 l=2 nf=100
XMP1C   a1 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  w=1000 l=2 nf=100
XMP1D   a1 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  w=1000 l=2 nf=100
XMP2    a2 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  w=1000 l=2 nf=100
XMP2B   a2 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  w=1000 l=2 nf=100
XMP2C   a2 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  w=1000 l=2 nf=100
XMP2D   a2 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  w=1000 l=2 nf=100
* PMOS double cascodes (bulk tied to source)
XMPC1A  m1 gpc1 a1 a1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=1 nf=100
XMPC1A2 m1 gpc1 a1 a1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=1 nf=100
XMPC1B  n1 gpc2 m1 m1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=1 nf=100
XMPC1B2 n1 gpc2 m1 m1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=1 nf=100
XMPC2A  m2 gpc1 a2 a2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=1 nf=100
XMPC2A2 m2 gpc1 a2 a2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=1 nf=100
XMPC2B  n2 gpc2 m2 m2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=1 nf=100
XMPC2B2 n2 gpc2 m2 m2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=1 nf=100
* NMOS double cascodes stacked on top of the input pair
XMC1B   n1 ngc2 y1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=200 l=1 nf=20
XMC1A   y1 ngc1 x1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=200 l=1 nf=20
XMC2B   n2 ngc2 y2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=200 l=1 nf=20
XMC2A   y2 ngc1 x2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=200 l=1 nf=20

* ---------------- first-stage common-mode feedback ----------------
* CM sense and passive CM return
R11     n1 ncm1 10meg
R12     n2 ncm1 10meg
RREF    ncm1 vref_cm 4meg
C11     ncm1 vss 10f
* vref_cm = vocm + 50uA*1k
XMPV    vref_cm nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=250 l=1 nf=1
R15     vref_cm vocm 1k
C12     vref_cm vss 1p
* vref_ea = vocm + 50uA*1.6k  (error-amp reference)
* PGS-tracking error-amp reference: n1 rises at fast-PMOS corners,
* falls at slow-PMOS corners, keeping output-stage source headroom.
R16A    PGS vref_ea 1.25meg
R16C    vdd vref_ea 1.55meg
R16B    vref_ea vss 1.8meg
C13V    vref_ea vss 1p
* low-transconductance, slow error amplifier driving the input-pair tail
XME1    e1 ncm1 sa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=20 l=1 nf=4
XME2    out_cm1 vref_ea sb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=20 l=1 nf=4
RSE1    sa se 22k
RSE2    sb se 22k
XME3    se iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=4 l=1 nf=1
XMPE1   e1 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=20 l=1 nf=4
XMPE2   out_cm1 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=20 l=1 nf=4
C13     out_cm1 vss 4.7u

* ---------------- second stage: PMOS common-source pair ----------------
XM5 voutp n1 s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.7 nf=100
XM5B voutp n1 s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.7 nf=100
XM5C voutp n1 s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.7 nf=100
XM5D voutp n1 s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.7 nf=100
XM6 voutn n2 s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.7 nf=100
XM6B voutn n2 s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.7 nf=100
XM6C voutn n2 s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.7 nf=100
XM6D voutn n2 s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.7 nf=100
XM7A    s2 out_cm2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.5 nf=100
XM7B    s2 out_cm2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=1000 l=0.5 nf=100
* current-source loads, bias-referenced, with CM step shunts
XMS1    voutp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=200 l=1 nf=20
XMS1B   voutp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=200 l=1 nf=20
XMS2    voutn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=200 l=1 nf=20
XMS2B   voutn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=200 l=1 nf=20
RL1     voutp vss 1.8k
RL2     voutn vss 1.8k

* ---------------- second-stage (output) common-mode feedback ----------------
R24     voutp ncm2 20k
R25     voutn ncm2 20k
C24     ncm2 vss 100f
XME4    e4 ncm2 sa2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=20 l=1 nf=4
XME5    out_cm2 vocm sb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=20 l=1 nf=4
RSE4    sa2 se2 2k
RSE5    sb2 se2 2k
XME6    se2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=20 l=1 nf=8
XMPE3   e4 e4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=20 l=1 nf=4
XMPE4   out_cm2 e4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=20 l=1 nf=4
C25     out_cm2 vdd 0.5p

* ---------------- Miller compensation with nulling resistors ----------------
CC1     n1 zc1 0.65p
RZ1     zc1 voutp 80
CC2     n2 zc2 0.65p
RZ2     zc2 voutn 80

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

circuit:

* Two-stage Miller-compensated OTA with continuous-time output CMFB.

.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* 50uA reference diode (iref pin sinks 50uA to vss)

XMPB0 pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=34.2 nf=1
XMNB1 pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* 60uA branch -> NMOS tail bias diode (tail replica /10)
XMPB1 ntb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=41 nf=1
XMNB2 ntb ntb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=19.3 nf=2
* 50uA branch -> PMOS cascode gate bias
XMPB2 ncp pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=34.2 nf=1
XMNB3 ncp ncp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3.30 nf=1
* 50uA branch -> NMOS cascode gate bias
XMPB3 ncn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=34.2 nf=1
XMNB4 ncn ncn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10.1 nf=1

*======================= input stage =======================
* NMOS differential pair + tail current source
XMTL tl ntb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=187 nf=4
XM1L al vinp tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=66 nf=2
XM2L bl vinn tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=66 nf=2
XM1R ar vinn tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=66 nf=2
XM2R br vinp tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=66 nf=2
* PMOS mirror loads (left half drives voutn, right half drives voutp)
XM3L al al vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=103 nf=4
XM4L bl al vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=103 nf=4
XM3R ar ar vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=103 nf=4
XM4R br ar vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=103 nf=4

*======================= output stage =======================
* PMOS common-source signal device + PMOS cascode
XM5L cl bl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=160 nf=5
XM6L voutn ncp cl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=267 nf=8
XM5R cr br vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=160 nf=5
XM6R voutp ncp cr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=267 nf=8
* NMOS cascoded current sources, bottom gate from CMFB
XM7L dl x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=133 nf=4
XM8L voutn ncn dl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=133 nf=4
XM7R dr x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=133 nf=4
XM8R voutp ncn dr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=133 nf=4

*======================= Miller compensation =======================
CCL voutn nzl 500f
RZL nzl bl 1300
CCR voutp nzr 500f
RZR nzr br 1300

*======================= CMFB =======================
* sense network: resistive divider with matched bypass caps
RS1 voutp s 125k
RS2 s voutn 125k

* CMFB differential pair (v_sense vs vocm)

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* First stage : NMOS input pair + NMOS cascode + PMOS cascode load
* Second stage: complementary class-AB common-source output
* Miller compensation with nulling resistors.
* Continuous-time output CMFB injects current into the first-stage
* output nodes through an NMOS mirror driven by a current-mode error amp.
* All bias is generated from the 50uA iref pin.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- master references ----------------
* NMOS reference: W/L = 64, 50 uA.  Low current density keeps the
* mirror overdrive small so the input-pair tail keeps headroom.
XNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=16

* 50uA sink that sets the PMOS reference diode current
XNB1 nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=16
* PMOS reference diode: W/L = 20
XPB1 nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* second PMOS reference matched to the long-channel first-stage loads
XNB2 nb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=16
XPB2 nb2 nb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=10
CBP2 nb2 vdd 2p

* PMOS cascode gate bias: VDD - 1.3V (supply-referenced current source)
XBPC vbp_casc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=16
RBC vdd vbp_casc 24k
CBC vbp_casc vdd 2p

* NMOS cascode gate bias: fixed 1.2V generated by a supply-referenced
* PMOS current source into a resistor (does not track the supply)
XVN vbn nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RVN vbn vss 21k
CVN vbn vss 2p

* bias node bypass
CREF iref vss 2p
CBP nbp vdd 2p

* ---------------- first stage ----------------
* NMOS tail: W/L = 512 (8x reference) -> 400uA
XNTAIL s iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=512 nf=128

* NMOS input pair: 200uA each, W/L = 240
XN1 ns1 vinp s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=120 nf=30
XN2 ns2 vinn s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=120 nf=30

* NMOS cascodes: W/L = 200
XNC1 o1 vbn ns1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=50
XNC2 o2 vbn ns2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=50

* PMOS cascode loads: current source W/L = 88 -> 235uA
XPCS1 c1 nb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=176 nf=44
XPCS2 c2 nb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=176 nf=44
* PMOS cascodes: W/L = 200
XPCA1 o1 vbp_casc c1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=800 nf=200
XPCA2 o2 vbp_casc c2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=800 nf=200

* ---------------- class-AB output stage ----------------
* inverter equilibrium near mid-rail; sized P/N ~4.3 for symmetric overdrive
XNO1 voutp o1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=120 nf=30
XPO1 voutp o1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=384 nf=96
XNO2 voutn o2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=120 nf=30
XPO2 voutn o2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=384 nf=96

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
* differential load resistor: linearizes the output-stage compression
RD voutp voutn 3.5k
* nulling resistors remove the right-half-plane zero
CC1 o1 nz1 0.35p
RZ1 nz1 voutp 100
CC2 o2 nz2 0.35p
RZ2 nz2 voutn 100

* ---------------- output CMFB ----------------
* output common-mode sense, divided by two so the error amplifier
* stays in range even if the outputs approach either rail
RCM1 voutp vcms 100k
RCM2 voutn vcms 100k
RCM3 vcms vss 50k

* reference divider (vocm/2)
RVR1 vocm vref 10k
RVR2 vref vss 10k
CVR vref vss 1p

* current-mode error amplifier: PMOS pair, NMOS mirror load,
* PMOS tail 100uA.  A constant 50uA PMOS injects into the summing
* node y so the NMOS mirror has a 50uA baseline.
RDG1 s1 scp 1.5k
RDG2 s2 scp 1.5k
XPCFT scp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=72.5 nf=18
XPCF1 x vref s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=13
XPCF2 y vcms s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=13
XNCFA x x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=5
XNCFB y x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=5
XPBL y nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=7.5 nf=2

* NMOS mirror: diode y, outputs sink from o1/o2 (1:1, 50uA nominal)
XNCMD y y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNCM1 d1 y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNCM2 d2 y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNCMC1 o1 nbp d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNCMC2 o2 nbp d2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Two-stage: NMOS input pair + PMOS current-source loads
* Class-A NMOS output driver / PMOS current source
* Continuous-time internal and output CMFB with local NMOS shunts
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* 50uA reference diode
XMND   iref  iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=10  nf=2
* mirror 50uA into the PMOS bias diode
XMNB2  pb    iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=10  nf=2
XMPB   pb    pb    vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20  nf=2
* 0.775V internal common-mode reference (50uA through diode)
XMVR   vrefi vrefi vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=10  nf=2
XMPVR  vrefi pb    vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20  nf=2
* second PMOS bias (higher gate voltage = lower overdrive) for output sources
XMNB3  pb2   iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=10  nf=2
XMPB2  pb2   pb2   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80  nf=2
* low-gm PMOS load bias
XMNB4  pb3   iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=10  nf=2
XMPB3  pb3   pb3   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5   nf=1
* 0.63V LVT reference for the CM error-amplifier tails
XVL    vlvt  vlvt  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMPVL  vlvt  pb    vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20  nf=2

* ---------------- first stage ----------------
* 300uA tail
XMT    tail  iref  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=60  nf=2
* input pair, 150uA per side
XM1    nca   vinp  tail  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96 nf=4
XM2    ncb   vinn  tail  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96 nf=4
* NMOS cascodes to boost first-stage output resistance
XMC1   a     vcasc nca   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=34 nf=1
XMC2   b     vcasc ncb   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=34 nf=1
* cascode bias divider (1.2V), bypassed
RVC1   vdd   vcasc 33k
RVC2   vcasc vss   67k
CVC    vcasc vss   10p
* PMOS current-source loads, 200uA each
XMP1   a     pb3   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=43  nf=1
XMP2   b     pb3   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=43  nf=1

* ---------------- internal common-mode feedback ----------------
* sense average of internal nodes
RIA    a     cmi   500k
RIB    b     cmi   500k
XMI1   ei_d  cmi   eis   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMI2   eo_i  vrefi eis   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMIT   eis   vlvt  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RLI    vdd   ei_d  43k
RLIO   vdd   eo_i  43k
* internal common-mode shunts
XMSI1  a     eo_i  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5  nf=1
XMSI2  b     eo_i  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5  nf=1
CCI    eo_i  vss   1u

* ---------------- output stage ----------------
* class-A NMOS drivers, ~1mA each, with cascodes for gain
XM5    n5     a     vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=180 nf=2
XC5A   voutp  vcasc2 n5   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=450 nf=4
XC5B   voutp  vcasc2 n5   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=450 nf=4
XM6    n6     b     vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=180 nf=2
XC6A   voutn  vcasc2 n6   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=450 nf=4
XC6B   voutn  vcasc2 n6   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=450 nf=4
* PMOS current sources, ~1.3mA each, with cascodes
XMP7A  np7    pb2   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=8
XMP7B  np7    pb2   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=8
XPC7A  voutp  pcasc np7   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=650 nf=8
XPC7B  voutp  pcasc np7   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=650 nf=8
XMP8A  np8    pb2   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=8
XMP8B  np8    pb2   vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=8
XPC8A  voutn  pcasc np8   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=650 nf=8
XPC8B  voutn  pcasc np8   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=650 nf=8
* cascode bias dividers
RVC3   vdd   vcasc2 55k
RVC4   vcasc2 vss  45k
CVC2   vcasc2 vss  10p
RPC1   vdd   pcasc 72k
RPC2   pcasc vss   28k
CPC    pcasc vss   10p

* ---------------- output common-mode feedback ----------------
ROA    voutp cmo   100k
ROB    voutn cmo   100k
XMO1   eo_d  cmo   eos   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMO2   eo_o  vocm  eos   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMOT   eos   vlvt  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RLO    vdd   eo_d  43k
RLOO   vdd   eo_o  43k
* output common-mode shunts with cascodes
XMSO1  ns1   eo_o  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=20 nf=1
XSC1A  voutp scasc ns1   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=136 nf=2
XSC1B  voutp scasc ns1   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=136 nf=2
XMSO2  ns2   eo_o  vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=20 nf=1
XSC2A  voutn scasc ns2   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=136 nf=2
XSC2B  voutn scasc ns2   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=136 nf=2
RSC1   vdd   scasc 55k
RSC2   scasc vss   45k
CSC    scasc vss   10p
CCO    eo_o  vss   200f

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
RZ1    voutp ncz1  120
CZ1    ncz1  a     400f
RZ2    voutn ncz2  120
CZ2    ncz2  b     400f

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA.
* Structure:
*  - first stage: NMOS input pair with PMOS mirror load (diode node na,
*    mirror node nb); LVT mirror keeps na/nb near ~1.1 V,
*  - second stage: NMOS differential pair driven by (nb - na) with its own
*    tail current, PMOS current-source loads controlled by continuous-time
*    output common-mode feedback,
*  - all bias currents derived from the single external 50 uA reference.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generation from external 50 uA reference (iref -> vss)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMBIASN iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.5 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* First stage: NMOS input pair + PMOS mirror load
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XM0 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=48 l=0.5 nf=8
XM1A na vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=48 l=0.75 nf=8
XM1B nb vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=48 l=0.75 nf=8
XM3A na na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=96 l=1 nf=16
XM3B nb na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=96 l=1 nf=16

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Second stage: NMOS differential pair + PMOS current-source loads
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XM5T stail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=72 l=0.5 nf=12
XM5A voutp na stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=48 l=0.75 nf=8
XM5B voutn nb stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=48 l=0.75 nf=8
XM6A voutp vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=96 l=1 nf=16
XM6B voutn vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=96 l=1 nf=16

* Miller compensation on the first-stage mirror (gain) node.
CCMCB voutn rzc2 600f
RZCB rzc2 nb 600

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Continuous-time common-mode feedback
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RCMA voutp vcms 25k
RCMB voutn vcms 25k
XM0CM cmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=36 l=0.5 nf=6
XM7A xcms vcms cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=36 l=0.5 nf=6
XM7B vcmfb vocm cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=36 l=0.5 nf=6
XM9A xcms xcms vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=30 l=0.5 nf=5
XM9B vcmfb xcms vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=30 l=0.5 nf=5

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated OTA
* for capacitive sampling-feedback load (Cs=1pF, Cf=125fF, CL=250fF).
*
* Stage 1: folded cascode, NMOS input pair, cascode NMOS loads
* Stage 2: common-source output stage
* Two continuous-time CMFB loops:
*   - stage-1 CMFB pins vop1/von1 common mode to vref1 (sets stage-2 bias)
*   - output CMFB pins voutp/voutn common mode to vocm
* All bias voltages generated internally from iref (50 uA).
*
* Device set: nfet_01v8 (NMOS) and pfet_01v8_lvt (low-Vt PMOS).

.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generation (iref = 50 uA pulled from vdd)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS reference: iref flows through diode MNREF (iref = Vgs(MNREF))
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
* PMOS reference: MPREF diode fed by an iref-mirrored NMOS sink
XMPREF pb   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
XMN1   pb   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8

* NMOS cascode bias: ncas = ncasb + 50u*Rncas
XMP2   ncas pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
RNCA   ncas ncasb 5.2k
XMNC1  ncasb ncasb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8

* Stage-1 common-mode reference (vref1 ~ 0.85 V)
XMPC2  vref1 pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
XMNR2  vref1 vref1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=7 nf=2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 1: folded cascode, NMOS input pair
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMT1    tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=288 nf=72
XMINP   fp   vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=60 nf=18
XMINN   fn   vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=60 nf=18

* Fold current sources (PMOS, lvt)
XMPFP   fp   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=112 nf=28
XMPFN   fn   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=112 nf=28

* PMOS cascodes (lvt, gate driven by stage-1 CMFB)
XMPCP   vop1 pcas fp   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=40
XMPCN   von1 pcas fn   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=40

* NMOS cascodes + bottom tails (high-impedance cascode loads)
XMNCP   vop1 ncas ns1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=24
XMNCN   von1 ncas ns2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=24
XMT2    ns1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=24
XMT3    ns2  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=24

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage-1 CMFB: sense (vop1+von1)/2, drive pcas
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
RSC1    vop1 vs1 10meg
RSC2    von1 vs1 10meg
XMC1    cfb1s vs1   cmt1s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMC2    pcas  vref1 cmt1s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMCT1   cmt1s iref  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
XMC3    cfb1s cfb1s vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMC4    pcas  cfb1s vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
CPCAS   pcas  vdd 100n

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 2: common-source output stage
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMN2P   voutp vop1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=34 nf=12
XMN2N   voutn von1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=34 nf=12
XMP2P   voutp vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=40
XMP2N   voutn vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=40

* Miller compensation
CCP     vop1 voutp 400f
CCN     von1 voutn 400f

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output CMFB: resistor sense + NMOS-input diff pair, PMOS mirror load
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
RCM1    voutp vcms 200k
RCM2    voutn vcms 200k
XMCM1   cfb1 vcms cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMCM2   vcmfb vocm cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMCM3   cmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=24
XMCM4   cfb1 cfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMCM5   vcmfb cfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
RCMFBS  vcmfb cmfbz 20k
CCMFBS  cmfbz vss 1p

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (gain 8, 10ns settling, 1mVrms noise)
* Two-stage Miller-compensated amplifier with two common-mode feedback loops:
*  - a slow first-stage CMFB that pins the first-stage output common mode by
*    steering the first-stage tail current, and
*  - a fast output CMFB that drives the second-stage PMOS loads so the output
*    common mode tracks vocm (single output-node pole, hence fast and stable).
*
* Pin order: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generation.  iref (50uA nominal) is the only external analog port.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XBN   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XBN2  nb   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XBP   nb   nb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* Reference for the first-stage CMFB (~0.7 V): PMOS mirror into an NMOS diode.
XREFP nref nb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=4  nf=1
XREFN nref nref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=6  nf=2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* First stage: NMOS differential pair with PMOS current-source loads.
* Tail current is steered by the first-stage CMFB voltage vcmfb1.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMT1  tail1 vcmfb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=132 nf=27
XM1   v1p   vinp   tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=32
XM2   v1n   vinn   tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=32
XML1  v1p   nb     vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16  nf=4
XML2  v1n   nb     vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16  nf=4

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Second stage: NMOS common-source output stage with PMOS current-source loads.
* The PMOS loads are driven by the output CMFB voltage vcmfb2.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XM5   voutp v1p    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XM6   voutn v1n    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XM7   voutp vcmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=38 nf=6
XM8   voutn vcmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=38 nf=6

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Miller compensation with nulling resistors.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RZP   v1p  nzp  300
CCP   nzp  voutp 0.7p
RZN   v1n  nzn  300
CCN   nzn  voutn 0.7p

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* First-stage common-mode feedback (slow).  Resistor sense of v1p/v1n, a
* low-gain diode-loaded error amplifier, and the tail as the actuator.
* vcmfb1 rises when the first-stage output CM rises, increasing the tail
* current and pulling v1p/v1n back down.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RS1A  v1p  v1cm 200k
RS2A  v1n  v1cm 200k
XMCT1 ctail1 iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMC1A dcp1  v1cm  ctail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMC2A vcmfb1 nref ctail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMC3A dcp1  dcp1  vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
XMC4A vcmfb1 vcmfb1 vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output common-mode feedback (fast).  Resistor sense of the output CM, a
* diode-loaded error amplifier with a large sense-pair current (low output
* impedance), driving the second-stage PMOS loads.  When the output CM rises
* above vocm, vcmfb2 rises, weakening the PMOS loads and pulling the output
* CM back down.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RS1   voutp vcms 20k
RS2   voutn vcms 20k
XMCT2 ctail2 iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
XMC1B dcp2  vcms  ctail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=16
XMC2B vcmfb2 vocm ctail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=16
XMC3B dcp2  dcp2  vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XMC4B vcmfb2 vcmfb2 vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=6

.ends sampling_feedback_ota
