taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential folded-cascode OTA with continuous-time common-mode
* feedback.  All bias voltages and the output common-mode loop are generated
* internally from the single 50uA reference current at `iref`.
*
* Signal path (one side): NMOS input pair (M1/M2) -> folded node (f1/f2) ->
* PMOS cascode (M5/M6) -> output.  The output is stacked between the PMOS
* cascode (up) and an NMOS cascode + sink (down) for a large dc gain.  The
* CMFB senses the output common mode against vocm and drives the gate of the
* PMOS top sources (M3/M4), so it has direct authority over the output CM.
*
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* vinp drives voutn and vinn drives voutp so voutp-voutn = +A*(vinp-vinn).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ========================= Bias reference =========================
* iref sinks 50uA through a diode NMOS; node iref = Vbn_sink (~0.71V).
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

* PMOS reference: 50uA diode mirror (pb_ref ~0.63V).
XMNPRF pb_ref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMPRF pb_ref pb_ref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

* =============== Cascode bias (diode + series drop) ===============
* NMOS cascode gate vbn_casc = Vgs(diode) + 0.25V ~ 0.96V.
* PMOS source pulls 50uA up through the diode so the resistor adds a fixed
* Vov margin for the bottom sink.
XMPB vbn_casc pb_ref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
RBN vbn_casc nbdio 5k
XNBDIO nbdio nbdio vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

* PMOS cascode gate vbp_casc = Vsg(diode) - 0.25V ~ 0.38V.
XMPBD pb_dio pb_dio vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
RBP pb_dio vbp_casc 5k
XNBP vbp_casc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

* ========================= Main OTA =========================
* NMOS input pair (200uA each), tail 400uA.
XM1 f1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=20
XM2 f2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=20
XMT tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=20

* PMOS top sources (~272uA each), gate driven by the CMFB voltage cm_b.
* Sized to mirror the CMFB diode at a low current density so Vsd is small.
XM3 f1 cm_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=112 nf=14
XM4 f2 cm_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=112 nf=14

* PMOS cascodes (100uA each): vinp-side f1 -> voutn, vinn-side f2 -> voutp.
XM5 voutn vbp_casc f1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=8
XM6 voutp vbp_casc f2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=8

* NMOS cascodes + sinks (100uA each).
XM7 voutn vbn_casc s7 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=4
XM8 voutp vbn_casc s8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=4
XM9 s7 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=4
XM10 s8 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=4

* ===================== Continuous CMFB =====================
* Two matched NMOS diff pairs sense (voutp, voutn) against vocm on one shared
* tail.  The output-sense drains feed the diode PMOS cm_a (mirror reference);
* the vocm drains feed the mirror output cm_b.  cm_b is a high-gain node that
* drives the PMOS top sources M3/M4.  Output CM up -> output-sense current up
* -> cm_a down -> mirror pushes cm_b up -> M3/M4 weaken -> output CM down.
XMCMT cm_tailn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=3
XMCMPA cm_a voutp cm_tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMCMNA cm_a voutn cm_tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMCMPB cm_b vocm cm_tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMCMNB cm_b vocm cm_tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMCMDIODE cm_a cm_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMCMMIR cm_b cm_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA.
* Two-stage: NMOS-input telescopic-cascode gain stage (d1,d2),
* PMOS common-source output stage (voutp,voutn), Miller compensation
* with nulling resistors. Two continuous-time CMFB loops:
*   - output CM (vocs vs vocm) steers NMOS output-stage loads (nctl)
*   - stage-1 CM (vs1 vs vocm) steers the input tail (tctl)
* All internal biases are derived from the single external iref port.
* Geometry convention: 5um fingers (avoids BSIM binning parameter
* excursions at small per-finger widths).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- biasing
* iref sinks 50u to vss through a diode NMOS; creates the nbias gate (iref).
XNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
* Mirror 50u into the PMOS diode branch; creates pbias gate pgd.
XNCP  pgd  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XPREF pgd  pgd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2

* Wide-swing NMOS cascode bias stack (25u): vdd-PMOScs-ncg-MNdiode-xn-MNcs-vss
XPNCS ncg pgd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XNST1 ncg ncg xn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XNST0 xn  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1

* Wide-swing PMOS cascode bias stack (25u): vdd-MPdiode-pcg-MPcs-yp-NMOScs-vss
XPST1 pcg pcg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XPST0 yp  pgd pcg vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XNPS  yp  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1

* ----------------------------------------------------- stage 1: telescopic
* NMOS tail (gate driven by stage-1 CMFB), input pair, NMOS cascodes,
* PMOS cascode loads to vdd. Differential outputs: d1, d2.
XTAIL tn  tctl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XIN1  n1  vinp tn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=12
XIN2  n2  vinn tn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=12
XNC1  d1  ncg  n1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XNC2  d2  ncg  n2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XPC1  p1  pcg  d1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=110 nf=22
XPC2  p2  pcg  d2  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=110 nf=22
XPTP1 p1  pgd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XPTP2 p2  pgd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12

* ------------------------------------------------------- stage 2: outputs
* PMOS common-source drivers (1mA), NMOS current-source loads (gates nctl).
XP21 voutp d1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=360 nf=72
XP22 voutn d2   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=360 nf=72
XN21 voutp nctl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
XN22 voutn nctl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=16

* Miller compensation with nulling resistors.
RZ1 d1 z1 100
RZ2 d2 z2 100
CC1 z1 voutp 220f
CC2 z2 voutn 220f

* --------------------------------------- output CMFB loop (target: vocm)
RSO1 voutp vocs 500k
RSO2 voutn vocs 500k
XOTA  vcta iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XOA1  vca1 vocs vcta vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XOA2  nctl vocm vcta vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XOL1  vca1 vca1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XOL2  nctl vca1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
CCA   nctl vss 300f
* Weak startup/definition resistor toward nominal target (iref).
RNA   nctl iref 5meg

* --------------------------------------- stage-1 CMFB loop (target: vocm)
RSS1 d1 vs1 500k
RSS2 d2 vs1 500k
XOTB vctb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XOB1 vcb1 vs1  vctb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XOB2 tctl vocm vctb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XBL1 vcb1 vcb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XBL2 tctl vcb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
CCB  tctl vss 200f
* Weak startup/definition resistor toward nominal target (iref).
RTB  tctl iref 5meg

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage OTA with continuous-time CMFB.
*   Stage 1: PMOS-LVT input pair (plain PMOS tail), L=2 NMOS current-source
*            loads whose gates are driven by CMFB loop 1.
*   Stage 2: crossed NMOS common-source outputs with PMOS current-source
*            loads, gates driven by CMFB loop 2.
*   Compensation: Miller Cc + nulling Rz across each stage-2 path.
*   All internal biases are mirrored from the single 50 uA iref port.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- Bias branch ----------------
* 50 uA NMOS diode on iref: reference NMOS gate voltage.
XMN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5
* 50 uA NMOS mirror feeding a PMOS diode: reference PMOS gate voltage pbias.
XMN1 pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5
XMP0 pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=30 l=0.5 nf=4

* PMOS cascode-gate bias: two stacked PMOS diodes sunk by 20 uA.
XMCT  px pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=0.5 nf=2
XMCBT pbc pbc px   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=0.5 nf=2
XMCSN pbc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.8 l=0.5

* ---------------- Stage 1 (differential) ----------------
* PMOS tail.
XMTAIL s1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=480 l=0.7 nf=16
* PMOS-LVT input pair.
XMIP pdp vinp s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=80 l=0.35 nf=10
XMIN pdn vinn s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=80 l=0.35 nf=10
* PMOS cascodes.
XMPCP dip pbc pdp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=16 l=0.35 nf=4
XMPCN din pbc pdn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=16 l=0.35 nf=4
* Long NMOS current-source loads, gates set by CMFB loop 1.
XMNLP dip cmfb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=1
XMNLN din cmfb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=1

* ---------------- Stage 2 (crossed common-source) ----------------
* voutp follows vinp: M2P is driven from the n-side stage-1 node.
XM2P voutp din vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=4
XM2N voutn dip vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=4
XMP2P voutp cmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=0.5 nf=8
XMP2N voutn cmfb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=0.5 nf=8
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor.
RZP din ccsp 150
CCP ccsp voutp 0.3p
RZN dip ccsn 150
CCN ccsn voutn 0.3p

* ---------------- Output CM sense (stage 2) ----------------
RSP1 voutp vs2 100k
RSN1 voutn vs2 100k
XAMP2 vss vs2 vocm iref vdd cmfb2 cmfb_amp
CINT2 cmfb2 vss 2p
* Weak startup level-set: defines CMFB nodes before the loops acquire.
RSTART2 cmfb2 vocm 10meg

* ---------------- Internal CM sense (stage 1) ----------------
RSP2 dip vs1 100k
RSN2 din vs1 100k
XAMP1 vss vs1 iref iref vdd cmfb1 cmfb_amp
CINT1 cmfb1 vss 5p
RSTART1 cmfb1 iref 10meg

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

* Continuous-time CMFB error amplifier: NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load.
* Output rises when vinp (sense) rises relative to vinn (target).
.subckt cmfb_amp vss vinp vinn iref vdd vout
XMT  s  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.5
XMI1 d1 vinp s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1
XMI2 vout vinn s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1
XMP1 d1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.2 l=0.5
XMP2 vout d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.2 l=0.5
.ends cmfb_amp

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ============================================================================
* 1. BIAS GENERATOR (IREF = 50 uA sourced into iref pin)
* ============================================================================
* Wide-swing degenerated NMOS bias reference (50 uA)
R_NB iref nb_gate 3.6k
XMN_BCAS nb_gate iref nb_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMN_BBOT nb_src nb_gate nb_deg vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=10 nf=2
R_NDEG_REF nb_deg vss 1.6k

* NMOS mirror branch (50 uA) to generate PMOS bias reference
XMN_PB_CAS pb_cas iref nb_pb_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMN_PB_BOT nb_pb_src nb_gate nb_pb_deg vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=10 nf=2
R_NDEG_PB nb_pb_deg vss 1.6k

* Wide-swing degenerated PMOS bias reference (50 uA)
R_PB pb_gate pb_cas 3.8k
XMP_BCAS pb_gate pb_cas pb_src vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMP_BTOP pb_src pb_gate pb_deg vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
R_PDEG_REF pb_deg vdd 1.6k

* Second-cascode bias for triple-cascode Stage 1 (50 uA branch)
* Generates ncas2_gate (~1.05 V) and pcas2_gate (~VDD - 1.05 V)
XMP_B2_TOP b2_psrc pb_gate b2_pdeg vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
R_PDEG_B2 b2_pdeg vdd 1.6k
XMP_B2_CAS ncas2_gate pb_cas b2_psrc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
R_B2_MID ncas2_gate pcas2_gate 5.0k
XMN_B2_CAS pcas2_gate iref b2_nsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMN_B2_BOT b2_nsrc nb_gate b2_ndeg vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=10 nf=2
R_NDEG_B2 b2_ndeg vss 1.6k

* Replica bias for Stage 2 NMOS and PMOS output devices (50 uA branch)
* Sets vbias_n2 (gate of Stage 2 NMOS) and vbias_p2 (gate of Stage 2 PMOS)
XMP_REP2_P vbias_p2 vbias_p2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMP_REP2_CAS vbias_n2 pb_cas vbias_p2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMN_REP2_N vbias_n2 vbias_n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* Input common-mode tracking cascode bias (25 uA = 0.5x branch)
XMP_ICM_TOP icm_psrc pb_gate icm_pdeg vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=10 nf=2
R_PDEG_ICM icm_pdeg vdd 3.2k
XMP_ICM_CAS vtail_rep pb_gate icm_psrc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
XMP_ICM_P icm_d vinp vtail_rep vtail_rep sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XMP_ICM_N icm_d vinn vtail_rep vtail_rep sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
R_ICM_DROP icm_d vcas_in 12k
XMN_ICM_CAS vcas_in iref icm_nsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN_ICM_BOT icm_nsrc nb_gate icm_ndeg vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=5 nf=1
R_NDEG_ICM icm_ndeg vss 3.2k

* ============================================================================
* 2. STAGE 1: HIGH-GAIN FOLDED-CASCODE DIFFERENTIAL AMPLIFIER
* ============================================================================
* Tail current source: 400 uA (8x 50 uA)
XMP_TAIL_TOP tail_mid pb_gate tail_deg vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160 nf=32
R_PDEG_TAIL tail_deg vdd 200
XMP_TAIL_CAS vtail pb_gate tail_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=160 nf=32

* Input differential pair (200 uA per side) + common-mode-bootstrapped cascode
* Note polarity: vinp -> fold_n -> v1n (fall) -> voutp (rise)
XMP_INP in_dp vinp vtail vtail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=32
XMP_INN in_dn vinn vtail vtail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=32
XMP_INCP fold_n vcas_in in_dp vtail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=96 nf=24
XMP_INCN fold_p vcas_in in_dn vtail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=96 nf=24

* Folded-cascode bottom NMOS current sinks: 350 uA per side (7x 50 uA)
XMN_FC_BOTP fold_p nb_gate fc_ndeg_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=70 nf=14
R_NDEG_FCP fc_ndeg_p vss 228.57
XMN_FC_BOTN fold_n nb_gate fc_ndeg_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=70 nf=14
R_NDEG_FCN fc_ndeg_n vss 228.57

* Folded-cascode NMOS double-cascode stack (150 uA = 3x 50 uA per side)
XMN_FC_CAS1P fc_nmid_p iref fold_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=6
XMN_FC_CAS1N fc_nmid_n iref fold_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=6
XMN_FC_CAS2P v1p ncas2_gate fc_nmid_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=36 nf=6
XMN_FC_CAS2N v1n ncas2_gate fc_nmid_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=36 nf=6

* Folded-cascode top PMOS current sources: 150 uA per side (3x 50 uA)
XMP_FC_TOPP fc_psrc_p pb_gate fc_pdeg_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=60 nf=12
R_PDEG_FCP fc_pdeg_p vdd 533.33
XMP_FC_TOPN fc_psrc_n pb_gate fc_pdeg_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=60 nf=12
R_PDEG_FCN fc_pdeg_n vdd 533.33
XMP_FC_CAS1P fc_pmid_p pb_cas fc_psrc_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=8
XMP_FC_CAS1N fc_pmid_n pb_cas fc_psrc_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=8
XMP_FC_CAS2P v1p pcas2_gate fc_pmid_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=48 nf=8
XMP_FC_CAS2N v1n pcas2_gate fc_pmid_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=48 nf=8

* Stage 1 local CMFB + differential gain-setting load referenced to vbias_n2
* Sets DC common mode of v1p, v1n to vbias_n2 while setting high differential R1
R_S1_P v1p v1_cm 400k
R_S1_N v1n v1_cm 400k
R_S1_CM v1_cm vbias_n2 5k

* ============================================================================
* 3. STAGE 2: RAIL-TO-RAIL OUTPUT STAGE (400 uA per side = 8x 50 uA)
* ============================================================================
* NMOS output common-source drivers driven by v1p, v1n
XMN_OUTP voutp v1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
XMN_OUTN voutn v1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=16

* PMOS output drivers controlled by continuous-time CMFB (vcmfb_p)
XMP_OUTP voutp vcmfb_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96 nf=16
XMP_OUTN voutn vcmfb_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96 nf=16

* Miller compensation with nulling resistors
R_MZP v1n mz_p 2.2k
C_MP mz_p voutp 300f
R_MZN v1p mz_n 2.2k
C_MN mz_n voutn 300f

* ============================================================================
* 4. CONTINUOUS-TIME OUTPUT CMFB AMPLIFIER
* ============================================================================
* Linear resistive common-mode sensing (zero doublet)
R_CMP voutp vcm_sense 25k
R_CMN voutn vcm_sense 25k
C_CMP voutp vcm_sense 20f
C_CMN voutn vcm_sense 20f
C_CM_SHUNT vcm_sense vss 40f

* High-speed CMFB error amplifier (200 uA tail = 4x 50 uA)
* Compares vcm_sense to vocm and drives vcmfb_p around vbias_p2
XMN_CM_TAIL cm_tail nb_gate cm_ndeg vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
R_NDEG_CM cm_ndeg vss 400
XMN_CM_CAS cm_tail_c iref cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8

* Differential pair: when vcm_sense < vocm, cm_in_sense conducts less,
* so cm_in_ref conducts more, pulling vcmfb_p DOWN to increase PMOS pull-up!
XMN_CM_SENSE cm_d_sense vcm_sense cm_tail_c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=16
XMN_CM_REF vcmfb_p vocm cm_tail_c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=16

* Active current-source load (100 uA per side = 2x 50 uA) + clamping resistor to vbias_p2
XMP_CM_LOAD_S cm_d_sense pb_gate cm_pdeg_s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
R_PDEG_CMS cm_pdeg_s vdd 800
XMP_CM_LOAD_R cm_r_src pb_gate cm_pdeg_r vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
R_PDEG_CMR cm_pdeg_r vdd 800
XMP_CM_CAS_R vcmfb_p pb_cas cm_r_src vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8

* Tie unused sense drain to vdd or mirror it, and reference vcmfb_p to vbias_p2
R_CMFB_GAIN vcmfb_p vbias_p2 18k
C_CMFB_COMP vcmfb_p vdd 150f

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Two-stage fully differential OTA for gain-8 capacitive sampling feedback.
* Internal bias generation from the single iref port; continuous-time CMFB.
* Stage 1: NMOS input pair, PMOS loads whose common gate self-biases to the
* average of the stage-1 outputs through matched resistors (high differential
* impedance, diode-like common-mode self bias -> no separate CMFB amplifier).
* Stage 2: PMOS common-source pair with NMOS loads whose gates are driven by
* a resistor-sensed continuous-time CMFB error amplifier.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* ---- internal reference bias (iref sinks 50uA from vdd) ----
XMNB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
XMNB1 pbx iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
XMPB0 pbx pbx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=150 nf=15
CNB iref vss 1p
CPB pbx vdd 1p
* ---- differential stage 1: NMOS input pair ----
XMNT sn1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=6
XMN1 a1 vinp sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=350 nf=35
XMN2 a2 vinn sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=350 nf=35
XMPLA a1 p1c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=900 nf=45
XMPLB a2 p1c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=900 nf=45
RS1A a1 p1c 2meg
RS1B a2 p1c 2meg
* ---- stage 2: PMOS common-source pair, NMOS CMFB-controlled loads ----
XMP5 voutp a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=740 nf=74
XMP6 voutn a2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=740 nf=74
XMN5 voutp nc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=370 nf=38
XMN6 voutn nc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=370 nf=38
* ---- differential Miller compensation ----
RCA a1 xca1 150
CCA xca1 voutp 0.3p
RCB a2 xcb1 150
CCB xcb1 voutn 0.3p
* ---- continuous-time output CMFB ----
RCS1 voutp sc 50k
RCS2 voutn sc 50k
XMNCST pcs iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1
XMC1 d1 sc pcs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMC2 nc vocm pcs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMPC1 d1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=20
XMPC2 nc d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=20

CCM1 nc voutp 0.3p
CCM2 nc voutn 0.3p

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA, gain 8 (Cs=1p, Cf=125f), CL=250f.
* Two-stage: LVT NMOS pair / cascoded PMOS loads (stage 1),
* fully telescopic cascoded PMOS + cascoded NMOS output stage (stage 2).
* High DC gain comes from cascoded loads; signal devices stay short/long-W
* for high gm and rail-to-rail swing. Two continuous-time CMFB loops.
* All internal biases derived from iref.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Stage 1: LVT NMOS differential pair, cascoded PMOS loads ----
XM1  n1n   vinn  s1    vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=156 l=1    nf=26
XM2  n1p   vinp  s1    vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=156 l=1    nf=26
XMT1 s1    ng1   vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      w=102 l=0.5  nf=17
XM3  y1n   pbias vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=252 l=1    nf=42
XM4  y1p   pbias vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=252 l=1    nf=42
XMC3 n1n   pcb   y1n   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=252 l=1    nf=42
XMC4 n1p   pcb   y1p   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=252 l=1    nf=42

* ---- Stage 2: telescopic cascoded output (PMOS signal) over cascoded NMOS load
* XM5/XM6 PMOS CS (gate = stage-1 output), XMC5/XMC6 PMOS cascode (gate=pcb),
* XM7/XM8 NMOS cascode (gate=ncb), XMN7/XMN8 NMOS CS (gate = CMFB node ng2).
XM5   xp   n1p   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=540 l=0.5 nf=54
XM6   xn   n1n   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=540 l=0.5 nf=54
XMC5  voutp pcb  xp   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=540 l=0.5 nf=54
XMC6  voutn pcb  xn   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=540 l=0.5 nf=54
XM7   voutp ncb   zn   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      w=320 l=0.5 nf=32
XM8   voutn ncb   zp   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      w=320 l=0.5 nf=32
XMN7  zn    ng2   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      w=320 l=0.5 nf=32
XMN8  zp    ng2   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      w=320 l=0.5 nf=32

* ---- Differential Miller compensation with nulling resistors ----
CC1  n1p  rc1p 0.35p
RZ1  rc1p voutp 1300
CC2  n1n  rc1n 0.35p
RZ2  rc1n voutn 1300

* ---- Bias block: iref (50u sourced from vdd) -> reference string ----
XMBN  iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=18 l=1 nf=3
XMBP  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=42 l=1 nf=7
XMBS  pbias iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=18 l=1 nf=3

* Cascode-gate biases (high-swing, near mid-supply), each a diode fed by a
* mirrored current source/sink.
* pcb: PMOS cascode gate (stage-1 loads XMC3/4 and output cascodes XMC5/6).
XRPC  pcb   pcb   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40  l=1 nf=8
XNPC  pcb   iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10  l=1 nf=2
* ncb: NMOS cascode gate (output cascodes XM7/8).
XPNC  ncb   pbias vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=24  l=1 nf=4
XRNC  ncb   ncb   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3   l=1 nf=1

* Replica defining stage-1 CM target (Vsg of output PMOS, density matched).
XM5R  vref1 vref1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=27 l=0.5 nf=5
XM7R  vref1 iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=12 l=1   nf=2

* ---- CMFB loop 2 (outputs): resistor/cap sense + 5-T error amp -> ng2 ----
RCM2P voutp vcm2 1.5meg
RCM2N vcm2  voutn 1.5meg
CSP2  voutp vcm2 0.3p
CSN2  vcm2  voutn 0.3p
XMA1  d2a   vcm2  s2a  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=6 l=0.5 nf=1
XMA2  ng2   vocm  s2a  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=6 l=0.5 nf=1
XMT2  s2a   iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     w=7 l=0.5 nf=1
XMA3  d2a   d2a   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     w=18 l=1  nf=3
XMA4  ng2   d2a   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     w=18 l=1  nf=3
* CM Miller compensation via the averaged output-CM node (zero diff load).
CCM2  ng2  rzcm 2.0p
RZCM  rzcm vcm2 500

* ---- CMFB loop 1 (stage-1 outputs): sense + error amp -> stage-1 tail ----
RCM1P n1p vcm1 1meg
RCM1N vcm1 n1n 1meg
CSP1  n1p vcm1 0.1p
CSN1  vcm1 n1n 0.1p
XMB1  d1a  vcm1 s1b  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=5 l=0.5 nf=1
XMB2  ng1  vref1 s1b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=5 l=0.5 nf=1
XMT1B s1b  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     w=5 l=0.5 nf=1
XMB3  d1a  d1a  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     w=12 l=1  nf=2
XMB4  ng1  d1a  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     w=12 l=1  nf=2
CCM1  ng1  vcm1 5.0p

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller-compensated OTA for capacitive sampling feedback.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ============================================================================
* Bias Generation from IREF (50 uA into iref node)
* ============================================================================
* Reference NMOS diode (50 uA, L=1.0, W=20 -> Vgs ~ 0.62V, Vdsat ~ 0.12V)
XMN_REF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4

* Generate NMOS cascode bias vbnc (~ 0.85V) using 50 uA branch with high-Vgs diode
XMN_B1 n_b1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
XMP_B1 n_b1 n_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
XMP_B2 vbnc n_b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
XMN_B2 vbnc vbnc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=6 nf=2

* Generate PMOS cascode bias vbpc (~ VDD - 0.90V) and clean PMOS mirror bias vbp1
* Use a cascoded NMOS current source to isolate PMOS bias from VDD/VSS variations
XMN_B3 n_b3 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
XMN_B3C vbp1 vbnc n_b3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMP_B3 vbp1 vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8

XMN_B4 n_b4 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
XMN_B4C vbpc vbnc n_b4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMP_B4 vbpc vbpc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=12 nf=2

* ============================================================================
* Stage 1: LVT PMOS Input Folded Cascode + Shared-Path CMFB
* ============================================================================
* Tail current source for main differential pair: 300 uA (6x of 50 uA)
XMP_TAIL1 vtail vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=240 nf=24

* Main LVT PMOS differential pair (150 uA per side), bulk tied to vtail for high CMRR
XMP_INP vfold_p vinp vtail vtail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=180 nf=18
XMP_INN vfold_n vinn vtail vtail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=180 nf=18

* CMFB sensing network: matched resistive + capacitive divider from voutp, voutn
RCM_P voutp vcm_sense 25k
RCM_N voutn vcm_sense 25k
CCM_P voutp vcm_sense 150f
CCM_N voutn vcm_sense 150f

* Tail current source for CMFB differential pair: 200 uA (4x of 50 uA)
XMP_TAIL_CM vtail_cm vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160 nf=16

* CMFB LVT PMOS differential pair:
* vocm side splits equally (50 uA + 50 uA at balance) into vfold_p and vfold_n
* vcm_sense side goes to replica folding load n_cm_dump to match Vds
XMP_CM_REF_P vfold_p vocm vtail_cm vtail_cm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=6
XMP_CM_REF_N vfold_n vocm vtail_cm vtail_cm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=6
XMP_CM_SNS_P n_cm_dump vcm_sense vtail_cm vtail_cm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=6
XMP_CM_SNS_N n_cm_dump vcm_sense vtail_cm vtail_cm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=6
XMN_CM_DUMP n_cm_dump vbnc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4

* Bottom NMOS folding current sources: 350 uA per side (7x of 50 uA)
* (150 uA from input pair + 50 uA from CMFB pair + 150 uA from top cascode = 350 uA)
XMN_FOLD_P vfold_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=140 nf=14
XMN_FOLD_N vfold_n iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=140 nf=14

* NMOS cascode devices (150 uA per side)
XMN_CASC_P v1p vbnc vfold_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=8
XMN_CASC_N v1n vbnc vfold_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=8

* Top PMOS cascode current source loads: 150 uA per side (3x of 50 uA)
XMP_LOAD_P n_pload_p vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=120 nf=12
XMP_LOAD_N n_pload_n vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=120 nf=12
XMP_CASC_P v1p vbpc n_pload_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=12
XMP_CASC_N v1n vbpc n_pload_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=12

* ============================================================================
* Stage 2: High-Swing Common-Source Output Stage (750 uA per side, 15x of 50 uA)
* ============================================================================
* PMOS common-source output drivers driven by v1p, v1n
XMP_OUTP voutp v1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=300 nf=30
XMP_OUTN voutn v1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=300 nf=30

* NMOS current source active loads (750 uA per side, L=1.0 for high Rout and low Vdsat)
XMN_OUTP voutp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=300 nf=30
XMN_OUTN voutn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=300 nf=30

* ============================================================================
* Miller RC Compensation Network
* ============================================================================
RZ_P v1p n_mz_p 1.2k
CC_P n_mz_p voutp 450f
RZ_N v1n n_mz_n 1.2k
CC_N n_mz_n voutn 450f

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* =========================================================================
* 1. Bias Generation (from 50uA iref sourced from vdd into iref)
*    Unit NMOS (50uA): L=2.0, W=12 (low gm/Id for low current-source noise!)
*    Unit PMOS (50uA): L=1.5, W=30 (low gm/Id for low current-source noise!)
* =========================================================================
XMB0 nb0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=12 nf=4
XMBC0 iref vbnc nb0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* Mirror iref via cascoded NMOS to generate PMOS reference bias vbp
XMB1 nb1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=12 nf=4
XMBC1 vbp vbnc nb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMPB0 pb0 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=30 nf=6
XMPBC0 vbp vbpc pb0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8

* Bias vbnc branch with 50uA from vbp (sets V(fold_p) ~ 0.38V)
XMPB_NC vbnc vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=30 nf=6
XMB_NC vbnc vbnc vnc_mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
RBNC vnc_mid vss 7.2k

* Generate PMOS cascode bias vbpc (for folding load cascode)
XMB2 nb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=12 nf=4
XMBC2 vbpc vbnc nb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMPB_PC vbpc vbpc vpc_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
RBPC vdd vpc_mid 6.5k

* Generate LVT PMOS cascode bias vbpc_lvt (for tail current source cascode)
XMB3 nb3 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=12 nf=4
XMBC3 vbpc_lvt vbnc nb3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMPB_PCL vbpc_lvt vbpc_lvt vpcl_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
RBPCL vdd vpcl_mid 5.2k

* =========================================================================
* 2. Stage 1: Low-Noise High-Gain PMOS-Input Folded Cascode Amplifier
*    Tail current = 18 * 50uA = 900uA (450uA per side)
*    Top PMOS folding current = 3 * 50uA = 150uA per side
*    Bottom NMOS current = 600uA per side (450uA fixed + 150uA CMFB)
* =========================================================================
* Cascoded tail current source (900uA = 18 * 50uA -> W=540 at L=1.5)
XMTAIL tail_m vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=540 nf=54
XMTAILC vtail vbpc_lvt tail_m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=540 nf=54

* PMOS LVT input differential pair (high gm, moderate Cin, bulk=vtail)
XMINP fold_p vinp vtail vtail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.45 w=270 nf=27
XMINN fold_n vinn vtail vtail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.45 w=270 nf=27

* Bottom NMOS current sources at folding nodes (low gm for low thermal noise!):
* 450uA fixed (9 * 50uA -> L=2.0, W=108) + 150uA CMFB (3 * 50uA -> L=0.6, W=30)
XML1P_FIX fold_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=108 nf=12
XML1N_FIX fold_n iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=108 nf=12
XML1P_CM fold_p vcm1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=30 nf=6
XML1N_CM fold_n vcm1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=30 nf=6

* Folding NMOS cascode transistors (150uA per side, L=1.0 for high ro)
XMLC1P st1p vbnc fold_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=80 nf=8
XMLC1N st1n vbnc fold_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=80 nf=8

* Top cascoded PMOS active load in folded branch (150uA = 3 * 50uA -> L=1.5, W=90)
XMPL1P pl1p_d vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=90 nf=10
XMPL1N pl1n_d vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=90 nf=10
XMPLC1P st1p vbpc pl1p_d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=120 nf=12
XMPLC1N st1n vbpc pl1n_d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=120 nf=12

* Stage 1 local CMFB (high R for high gain; small XML1_CM gate C -> fast pole!)
RCM1P st1p vcm1 600k
RCM1N st1n vcm1 600k

* =========================================================================
* 3. Stage 2: High-Swing Common-Source Output Stage (750uA per side)
* =========================================================================
* NMOS transconductors: 5x mirror of XML1P_CM (L=0.6, W=150 -> 750uA per side)
XM2P voutp st1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=150 nf=15
XM2N voutn st1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=150 nf=15

* PMOS active loads controlled by Output CMFB (L=0.8, W=450 -> 750uA at 1.667uA/um)
XMP2P voutp vcm2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=450 nf=45
XMP2N voutn vcm2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=450 nf=45

* Nulling-resistor Miller compensation
RCP st1p mz_p 750
CCP mz_p voutp 450f
RCN st1n mz_n 750
CCN mz_n voutn 450f

* =========================================================================
* 4. Continuous-Time Output CMFB Amplifier (Fast Pole + Matched Density)
* =========================================================================
* Resistive common-mode sensing (80k -> high Stage-2 gain + fast sense pole)
RCMP voutp vocm_s 80k
RCMN voutn vocm_s 80k

* Cascoded tail current source for CMFB amp: 4 * 50uA = 200uA (100uA per side)
XMCMT cmt_d iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=48 nf=8
XMCMTC vcm_tail vbnc cmt_d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=6

* Differential pair comparing vocm_s and vocm (small gate C for fast pole)
XMCM_SNS vcm2_d vocm_s vcm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=48 nf=8
XMCM_REF vcm2 vocm vcm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=48 nf=8

* Split PMOS load matched to XMP2P/N (100uA at L=0.8, W=60 -> 1.667uA/um):
* Left side: W=60 diode; Right side: W=48 mirror + W=12 diode (W_tot=60)
XMCML_D vcm2_d vcm2_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=60 nf=6
XMCML_M vcm2 vcm2_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=48 nf=6
XMCML_S vcm2 vcm2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=12 nf=2

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA.
* Two-stage Miller: NMOS-input folded-cascode stage1 (cascoded NMOS load,
* LVT-PMOS folding/cascode for headroom) + NMOS common-source stage2 with a
* PMOS current-source load. Continuous-time CMFB senses the output average,
* compares to vocm, and drives the STAGE-2 PMOS-LOAD gates. Closing the CMFB
* loop around stage2 only (not through stage1) keeps the CMFB loop gain at a
* moderate, ngspice-convergent level while still giving >50 dB CMRR.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ============ Bias references (iref = 50 uA) ============
* XBI0 diode sets the NMOS gate-bias voltage on iref (~0.76 V); every NMOS
* current source gates directly off iref (mirror ratio = width/12). bpl =
* LVT-PMOS gate (fixed folding current). ncas = NMOS cascode gate (~1.0 V).
* pcas = LVT-PMOS cascode gate (~0.44 V).
XBI0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=4
XBI8 bpl  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=4
XBI9 bpl  bpl  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
* ncas: resistor-fed NMOS diode (resistor gives a DC startup path)
RNC vdd ncas 16k
XBI4 ncas ncas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=2
* pcas: two LVT-PMOS diodes down from vdd, resistor-fed to vss
RPC pcas vss 6.5k
XBI6 pmid pmid vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XBI7 pcas pcas pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=4

* ============ Stage 1: NMOS-input folded cascode ============
* Tail Iss ~200 uA (w=48 -> 4x iref)
XS1T ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8
* Input pair (carry Iss/2 ~100 uA)
XS1P fn1 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8
XS1N fn2 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8
* Folding LVT-PMOS sources (Ifold ~200 uA, FIXED gate bpl)
XS1F1 fn1 bpl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=96 nf=16
XS1F2 fn2 bpl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=96 nf=16
* LVT-PMOS cascode (carry Icas = Ifold - Iin ~100 uA)
XS1C1 oa1 pcas fn1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=48 nf=8
XS1C2 oa2 pcas fn2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=48 nf=8
* NMOS cascoded current-sink load at oa (FIXED gate iref, ~100 uA sink).
* Stage1 interstage DC is set by the Ifold-Iin == Iload balance (both ratioed
* off iref, so they track) plus the 1-gigohm oa anchors; no active loop here.
XS1L1 nl1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XS1L2 nl2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XS1LC1 oa1 ncas nl1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XS1LC2 oa2 ncas nl2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4

* ============ Stage 2: NMOS common-source + PMOS load ============
* oa1 drives voutp, oa2 drives voutn (inverting stage -> non-inverting diff)
XS2P voutp oa1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8
XS2N voutn oa2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8
* PMOS load gates = pcmf (CMFB-controlled). Common to both halves (CM only).
XS2LP voutp pcmf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=16
XS2LN voutn pcmf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=16

* ============ Miller compensation (per branch, inverting) ============
RC1 m1c oa1 500
CC1 m1c voutp 300f
RC2 m2c oa2 500
CC2 m2c voutn 300f

* ============ DC anchors on high-Z gain nodes ============
* 1-gigohm resistors give each floating high-Z node a finite DC path so ngspice
* resolves a real operating point (otherwise gmin stepping collapses cascode
* nodes). <2 nA current and 4e-15 A/rtHz noise: negligible vs ~100 uA signals.
ROA1 oa1 vocm 1g
ROA2 oa2 vocm 1g
RFN1 fn1 vss 1g
RFN2 fn2 vss 1g
RNL1 nl1 vss 1g
RNL2 nl2 vss 1g
RNT  ntail vss 1g
RCMP voutp vocm 1g
RCMN voutn vocm 1g

* ============ Continuous-time CMFB (closes around stage2 only) ============
* Sense output average.
RSEN1 voutp cmfb 100meg
RSEN2 voutn cmfb 100meg
* Error amp: NMOS diff pair, tail off iref. XCM1 gate=vocm (reference side);
* its drain is the CMFB output pcmf. vout CM rise -> sense rise -> XCM1 off ->
* d1 falls -> mirror XCM4 sources more -> pcmf rises -> stage2 PMOS load
* weakens -> output pulled down (negative CMFB). Single gain stage in loop.
XCM0 tcm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=4
XCM1 pcmf vocm tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XCM2 d1   cmfb tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XCM3 d1   d1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XCM4 pcmf d1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
* CMFB dominant pole / DC anchor on the control node
CCFB pcmf vss 200f
RPCM pcmf vocm 1g
RTCM tcm vss 1g

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (gain 8, Cs=8Cf).
* Folded-cascode core (NMOS input, cascoded both sides) plus a
* continuous-time, bidirectional CMFB transconductor that injects
* correction current into both outputs. All biases from iref.
*
* vb_n1 = iref : NMOS reference (Vov~0.18, 50 uA).
* vb_p1 = pb   : PMOS reference (Vov~0.18, 50 uA).
* vb_ncas, vb_pcas : wide-swing cascode gates (Vth-tracking).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*
* ---- Bias generation from iref (50 uA) ----
XMNREF  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=30  nf=6
XMNPMIR pb   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=30  nf=6
XMPREF  pb   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=77  nf=13
* NMOS wide-swing cascode bias: diode (Vov~0.40) fed by a PMOS source.
XMPNCASF vb_ncas pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=77  nf=13
XMNNCASF vb_ncas vb_ncas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4   nf=1
* PMOS wide-swing cascode bias: diode (Vov~0.40) fed by an NMOS sink.
XMNPCASF vb_pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1  w=30  nf=6
XMPPCASF vb_pcas vb_pcas vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10  nf=2
*
* ---- Core folded-cascode OTA ----
XM1   fp   vinp  tnode vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=38  nf=10
XM2   fn   vinn  tnode vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=38  nf=10
XM0   tnode iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=360 nf=60
XMFIp fp   pb    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=772 nf=129
XMFIn fn   pb    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=772 nf=129
XMPCp voutp vb_pcas fp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=154 nf=26
XMPCn voutn vb_pcas fn  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=154 nf=26
XMNLp qnp  iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=120 nf=20
XMNLn qnn  iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=120 nf=20
XMNCp voutp vb_ncas qnp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=88  nf=16
XMNCn voutn vb_ncas qnn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=88  nf=16
*
* ---- Continuous-time bidirectional CMFB transconductor ----
RSP voutp vcms 1000meg
RSN vcms  voutn 1000meg
XMA0 ma_s pb   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=617 nf=103
XMA1 mx   vcms ma_s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=56  nf=28
XMA2 mb   vocm ma_s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=56  nf=28
* Source path: Ma1 -> Mn_a1(diode mx) -> Mn_a2 -> Mp_b(diode my) -> Mp_c.
XMNA1 mx   mx   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=88  nf=16
XMNA2 my   mx   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=88  nf=16
XMPB  my   my   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=154 nf=26
XMIPp voutp my  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=31  nf=6
XMIPn voutn my  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=31  nf=6
* Sink path: Ma2 -> Mn_b1(diode mb) -> Mn_d.
XMNB1 mb   mb   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=88  nf=16
XMIDp voutp mb  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18  nf=3
XMIDn voutn mb  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18  nf=3
*

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (SKY130)
* stage1: PMOS(LVT)-input folded cascode; stage2: PMOS-in CS + split NMOS pull-down
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*
* ---------------- bias ----------------
XQB   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
XQMI  npr  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
XQPB  npr  npr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
* NMOS-cascode gate bias stack: V(nci)=Vgs_b+Vgs_a ; fold node F=Vgs_b
XQNI  nci  npr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XQNA  nci  nci  ncb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XQNB  ncb  ncb  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
* PMOS-cascode gate bias for Y-load stack
XQPI  pc2  npr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XQPA  pc2  pc2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
*
* ---------------- stage 1 : folded cascode ----------------
XTAIL vst  npr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=600 nf=60
XINP  f1   vinp vst vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XINN  f2   vinn vst vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XFOLD1 f1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=200 nf=20
XFOLD2 f2  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=200 nf=20
XCASP  y1   nci  f1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XCASN  y2   nci  f2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XYCSP  y1   pc2  w1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=200 nf=20
XYCSN  y2   pc2  w2  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=200 nf=20
XYLDP  w1   q1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=258 nf=20
XYLDN  w2   q1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=258 nf=20
*
* ---------------- stage 2 ----------------
X2P   voutp y2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=200 nf=20
X2N   voutn y1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=200 nf=20
XPDFP voutp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=60 nf=6
XPDFN voutn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=60 nf=6
XPDCP voutp qq  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=27 nf=3
XPDCN voutn qq  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=27 nf=3
* 2nd-stage replica reference: V(nr2)=V(Y) target, I2=300uA
XQR2  nr2  nr2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=200 nf=20
XQR2N nr2  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=120 nf=12
*
* ---------------- CMFB1 : (y1+y2)/2 -> nr2 ----------------
XS1A  p1   y1   s1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=100 nf=10
XS1B  q1   nr2  s1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=100 nf=10
XS2A  p1   y2   s2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=100 nf=10
XS2B  q1   nr2  s2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=100 nf=10
XS1T  s1   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=4
XS2T  s2   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=40 nf=4
XC1PL p1   p1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=100 nf=10
XC1QL q1   q1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=100 nf=10
*
* ---------------- CMFB2 : (voutp+voutn)/2 -> vocm ----------------
XS3A  pp   voutp s3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=67 nf=8
XS3B  qq   vocm  s3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=67 nf=8
XS4A  pp   voutn s4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=67 nf=8
XS4B  qq   vocm  s4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=67 nf=8
XS3T  s3   npr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XS4T  s4   npr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XC2PL pp   pp  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=29.4 nf=4
XC2QL qq   qq  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=29.4 nf=4
*
* ---------------- compensation ----------------
CC1 y1 voutn 250f
CC2 y2 voutp 250f

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA.
* NMOS-input folded-cascode core (single diff pair -> low noise),
* wide-swing cascode biasing, continuous-time current-injection CMFB.
* iref is the only external analog-bias port.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias from iref (50 uA).  iref node = nbias (NMOS sink gate bias).
* pbias   = PMOS current-source gate bias.
* nbcas   = NMOS wide-swing cascode gate bias.
* pcbcasp = PMOS output-cascode gate bias (set low enough to overcome
*           body effect on the output PMOS cascodes).
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMirefn iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=20.8  nf=11
XMnb    pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=1   w=20.8  nf=11
XMirefp vdd pbias pbias vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=1   w=31.25 nf=16

* NMOS wide-swing cascode reference: vdd->Mws_p -> nbcas diode -> Rn -> vss
XMws_p  vdd pbias nbcas vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=1   w=31.25 nf=16
XMws_nc nbcas nbcas nws2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=20.8  nf=11
Rn      nws2 vss 5k

* PMOS cascode reference: vss->Mws_n -> pcbcasp diode -> Rp -> vdd
XMws_n  pcbcasp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=1   w=20.8  nf=11
XMws_pc nws4 pcbcasp pcbcasp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=31.25 nf=16
Rp      nws4 vdd 6k
* (nws4 set ~1.5 to match Mcn source for body-effect tracking)

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Folded-cascode core (NMOS input).  Single diff pair.
*   vinp -> nfn -> Mcn -> voutn   (inverting)
*   vinn -> nfp -> Mcp -> voutp   (inverting)
* Folding node held high (near Vdd) by simple PMOS folding sources so the
* PMOS output cascodes turn on despite their body effect.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XM0   n_src iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2   w=39    nf=20
XM1   nfn vinp n_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1   w=20    nf=10
XM2   nfp vinn n_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1   w=20    nf=10

* PMOS folding current sources (Ifold > I1 so excess biases the output)
XMfn  vdd pbias nfn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8       l=3   w=291   nf=73
XMfp  vdd pbias nfp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8       l=3   w=291   nf=73

* PMOS output cascodes (signal path to outputs)
XMcn  nfn pcbcasp voutn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=3   w=234   nf=59
XMcp  nfp pcbcasp voutp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=3   w=234   nf=59

* NMOS output current sinks + cascodes (high-Z load at outputs)
XMbn  nbn2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8       l=3   w=62.4  nf=16
XMbnc voutn nbcas nbn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=3   w=62.4  nf=16
XMbp  nbp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8       l=3   w=62.4  nf=16
XMbpc voutp nbcas nbp2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=3   w=62.4  nf=16

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Continuous-time CMFB.  Sense output common mode (R avg + C for fast
* AC), compare to vocm with a PMOS diff pair, mirror the current into both
* outputs (common-mode injection only).  vcmc↑ -> more sink -> CM↓.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
R1 voutp vcmc 10meg
R2 voutn vcmc 10meg
C1 voutp vcmc 80f
C2 voutn vcmc 80f

XMcmt  vdd pbias ncmt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=93.75 nf=47
XMcm1  ncmt vocm mirrnode vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=88    nf=44
XMcm2  ncmt vcmc ncm2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=88    nf=44

XMmr   mirrnode mirrnode vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=31.2 nf=16
XMmr2  ncm2 ncm2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1   w=31.2  nf=16

XMmn   voutp mirrnode vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=31.2  nf=16
XMmp   voutn mirrnode vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=31.2  nf=16

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage OTA for a capacitive sampling-feedback load
* Stage 1: NMOS(lvt)-input telescopic cascode, output CM = vocm
* Stage 2: PMOS common-source (gate = stage-1 output) with PMOS current-source
*          loads, output CM = vocm.  Miller compensation with a nulling resistor.
* CMFB1 senses the stage-1 common mode and drives the stage-1 tail.
* CMFB2 senses the output common mode and drives the stage-2 load gates.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias ----------------
* 50uA into iref: diode-connected NMOS fixes V(iref) = Vgs_n  (W/L = 10, L = 1)
XB_iref iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1

* PMOS mirror reference: vbp = vdd - Vsg_p(50u, W/L = 19)  -> Vov_p ~ 0.25
XB_pdiode vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=19 nf=1
XB_psink  vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1

* CMFB amplifier tail bias: vbp2 = vdd - Vsg_p(50u, W/L = 46) -> Vov_p ~ 0.16
XB_p2d vbp2 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=46 nf=3
XB_p2s vbp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1

* NMOS cascode bias: vcn = vxc + Vgs of a cascode-matched diode, vxc = 50u*8.8k
XB_p3 vcn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=19 nf=1
XB_d2 vcn vcn vxc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XB_r1 vxc vss 8.8k

* PMOS cascode bias: vcp ~ 0.15 V from a vdd divider
XB_r2 vdd vcp 165k
XB_r3 vcp vss 15k

* ---------------- stage 1 : telescopic cascode ----------------
* tail, 600uA, gate driven by CMFB1
XM_tail tail1 outcm1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=108 nf=6
* input pair, lvt for headroom, Vov ~ 0.12
XM_in1 dn1 vinp tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=4
XM_in2 dn2 vinn tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=4
* NMOS cascodes
XM_cas1 n1p vcn dn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=73 nf=4
XM_cas2 n1n vcn dn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=73 nf=4
* PMOS cascodes
XM_pcas1 n1p vcp up1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=114 nf=6
XM_pcas2 n1n vcp up2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=114 nf=6
* PMOS current sources
XM_src1 up1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=114 nf=6
XM_src2 up2 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=114 nf=6
* common-mode loop stabilisation capacitance at the stage-1 outputs
XC_cm1 n1p vss 4p
XC_cm2 n1n vss 4p

* ---------------- stage 2 : PMOS CS with PMOS current-source loads ----------
* inputs are the stage-1 outputs, sources at vdd
XM_out1 voutp n1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=194 nf=10
XM_out2 voutn n1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=194 nf=10
* loads, gates driven by CMFB2
XM_load1 voutp outcm2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=95 nf=5
XM_load2 voutn outcm2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=95 nf=5
* output resistors keep the loop gain flat across the output swing
XR_o1 voutp vss 20k
XR_o2 voutn vss 20k

* ---------------- compensation ----------------
XC_c1 n1p xrz1 0.4p
XM_rz1 xrz1 voutp 700
XC_c2 n1n xrz2 0.4p
XM_rz2 xrz2 voutn 700

* ---------------- CMFB1 : stage-1 common mode -> tail gate ----------------
* sense pair (gates at the stage-1 outputs, common source cms1)
XM_s1a vdd n1p cms1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13.7 nf=1
XM_s1b vdd n1n cms1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13.7 nf=1
XM_s1t cms1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1
* vocm-referenced replica
XM_s1r vdd vocm vreft1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13.7 nf=1
XM_s1rt vreft1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
* amplifier: PMOS input pair, NMOS diode loads, output drives the tail gate
XM_c1t tn1 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=93 nf=5
XM_c1a cd1 cms1 tn1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XM_c1b outcm1 vreft1 tn1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XM_c1d cd1 cd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XM_c1m outcm1 outcm1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1

* ---------------- CMFB2 : output common mode -> load gates -----------------
* sense pair (gates at the outputs, common source cms2)
XM_s2a vdd voutp cms2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13.7 nf=1
XM_s2b vdd voutn cms2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13.7 nf=1
XM_s2t cms2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1
* vocm-referenced replica
XM_s2r vdd vocm vreft2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13.7 nf=1
XM_s2rt vreft2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
* amplifier: PMOS input pair; NMOS mirror + PMOS diode give a 0.525 V output
XM_c2t tn2 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=93 nf=5
XM_c2a cd2 cms2 tn2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XM_c2b outcm2 vreft2 tn2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XM_c2d cd2 cd2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XM_c2m outcm2 cd2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XM_c2p outcm2 outcm2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=19 nf=1

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* IREF termination; all useful biasing is generated internally.
RREF iref vss 18k noisy=0

* Regenerative cross-coupled CMOS transconductor. Positive vinp-vinn raises
* voutp-voutn; the weak output-coupled pair boosts differential DC gain.

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (gain 8, 10ns settling, SKY130)
* Two-stage: telescopic-cascode first stage, common-source second stage.
* Stage-1 output CM is servo'd to vcm1r = vdd - Vsg(ref); output CM to vocm.
* Both CM loops use resistive sensing plus capacitive feed-through so the
* sensing network is pole-free, and bleed resistors referenced to the target
* common mode (zero DC current) give a fast common-mode recovery path.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ================= master bias =================
* IREF 50uA -> diode NMOS sets VGS_REF (~0.75V)
XMB0   iref  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=20  nf=4
XMBN1  nbp   iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=20  nf=4
XMBP0  nbp   nbp   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=10  nf=2
* tail bias vcmr : Vov 0.15V at 50uA, mirrored ~20x by XMt
XMBN2  vcmr  vcmr  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=26  nf=2
XMBP1  vcmr  nbp   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=10  nf=2
* stage-1 output common-mode reference: vcm1r = vdd - VSG(50uA, W/L=193)
XMBP3  vcm1r vcm1r vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=193 nf=2
XMBN3  vcm1r iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=20  nf=4
* NMOS cascode gate bias nbnc = 2 x VGS(50uA, W/L=80) ~ 1.26V
XMBNA  nbnc  nbnc  nmid vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=80  nf=2
XMBNB  nmid  nmid  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=80  nf=2
XMBPA  nbnc  nbp   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=10  nf=2
* PMOS cascode gate bias nbpc = vdd - VSG(50uA, W/L=4.5) ~ vdd-1.05V
* (referenced to vdd so the cascode drain-source margin is supply independent)
XMBPD  nbpc  nbpc  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=4.5 nf=1
XMBPS  nbpc  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=2 w=20  nf=4

* ================= stage 1 : telescopic cascode =================
XMt    t1n   vcmr  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=523 nf=4
XM1    d1    vinp  t1n  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=551 nf=4
XM2    d2    vinn  t1n  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=551 nf=4
XMc1   o1    nbnc  d1   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=288 nf=2
XMc2   o2    nbnc  d2   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=288 nf=2
XMp1   nc1   ceb1  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=310 nf=2
XMp2   nc2   ceb1  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=310 nf=2
XMpc1  o1    nbpc  nc1  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=552 nf=4
XMpc2  o2    nbpc  nc2  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=1 w=552 nf=4
* common-mode bleeds for the first stage: zero DC current at the nominal
* common mode, but they set the common-mode impedance seen by the CMFB loop
RBL1   o1    vcm1r 60k
RBL2   o2    vcm1r 60k

* ================= stage 2 : common-source output =================
XMo1   voutp o1    vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.35 w=1010 nf=4 m=2
XMo2   voutn o2    vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.35 w=1010 nf=4 m=2
XMq1   voutp ceb2  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=452 nf=4
XMq2   voutn ceb2  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=452 nf=4
* common-mode bleeds for the output stage: zero DC current at the nominal
* common mode, low common-mode impedance -> fast recovery from a disturbance
RBLP1  voutp vocm  1.6k
RBLP2  voutn vocm  1.6k

* ================= stage-1 common-mode feedback =================
RS1    o1    cm1   1meg
RS2    o2    cm1   1meg
CS1    o1    cm1   1p
CS2    o2    cm1   1p
XME1   cea1  cm1   cet1 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=118 nf=2
XME2   ceb1  vcm1r cet1 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=118 nf=2
XMET   cet1  vcmr  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=26  nf=2
RF1    cea1  vdd   30k
RF2    ceb1  vdd   30k
CCB1   ceb1  vss   100n

* ================= output common-mode feedback =================
RS3    voutp cm2   1meg
RS4    voutn cm2   1meg
CS3    voutp cm2   1p
CS4    voutn cm2   1p
XMF1   cea2  cm2   cet2 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=118 nf=2
XMF2   ceb2  vocm  cet2 vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=118 nf=2
XMFT   cet2  vcmr  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=1 w=26  nf=2
RF3    cea2  vdd   47k
RF4    ceb2  vdd   47k
CCB2   ceb2  vss   200p

* ================= miller compensation =================
CC1    o1    x1    2p
CC2    o2    x2    2p
RZ1    x1    voutp 20
RZ2    x2    voutn 20
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Implement the fully differential sampling-feedback OTA here.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* Reference-current termination. The signal path is self-biased from vin/vocm.
RBIAS iref vss 1

* Two cascaded inverter stages give positive differential gain.
* Stage 1: high-resistance voltage gain.
XP1P xp vinp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=8
XN1P xp vinp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=11
XP1N xn vinn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=8
XN1N xn vinn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=11
RXP xp vocm 120k
RXN xn vocm 120k
CXP xp vocm 1.6p
CXN xn vocm 1.6p

* Stage 2: output drive for the sampling-feedback capacitors.
XP2P yp xp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=32
XN2P yp xp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XP2N yn xn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=32
XN2N yn xn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
RYP yp vocm 120k
RYN yn vocm 120k
CYP yp vocm 20f
CYN yn vocm 20f

* Stage 3: crossed output drivers. The crossing keeps differential gain
* positive while the odd common-mode inversion damps sampled-CM excursions.
XP3P voutp yn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=20
XN3P voutp yn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XP3N voutn yp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=20
XN3N voutn yp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XRP voutp voutn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=30 nf=10
XRN voutp voutn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=2
XLP voutn voutp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=30 nf=10
XLN voutn voutp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=2

* Passive centering and local Miller compensation.
ROCP voutp vocm 1k
ROCN voutn vocm 1k
RDIF voutp voutn 1.745k
RZP yn czp 1k
CZP czp voutp 5p
RZN yp czn 1k
CZN czn voutn 5p
COCP voutp vocm 500f
COCN voutn vocm 500f
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* 50 uA external reference and local tail-current mirror.
XREF  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8  nf=2
XTAIL tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=16 nf=4

* Long-channel differential input pair and PMOS current-mirror load.
XINP n1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=64 nf=16
XINN n2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=64 nf=16
XPLD n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=24 nf=8
XPLM n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=24 nf=8

* Class-A push-pull output.  The PMOS devices are a common-mode-controlled
* source; the NMOS devices carry the differential signal from n1/n2.
XOP voutp c2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=512 nf=80
XON voutn c2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=512 nf=80
XNP voutp n1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=256 nf=40
XNN voutn n2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=256 nf=40

* Low-impedance average sensing and a matched NMOS/PMOS CMFB amplifier.
RSP cms voutp 10k
RSN cms voutn 10k
XCMT cmt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=16 nf=4
XCM1 c1 cms  cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=24 nf=4
XCM2 c2 vocm cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=24 nf=4
XCPL c1 c1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=32 nf=8
XCPS c2 c1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=32 nf=8

* Local compensation and a charge reservoir for the specified load pulse.
RCM cmfb c2 10
CCM cmfb vss 200f
CMLP n1 cp 75f
CMLN n2 cn 75f
RMLP cp voutp 100
RMLN cn voutn 100
RLOADP voutp vocm 10meg
RLOADN voutn vocm 10meg

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

XNPMIR pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XPPREF pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1

* High-gain NMOS input pair with long-channel PMOS loads.
XTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=10 nf=2
XINP x1 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=10 nf=2
XINN x2 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=10 nf=2
XLOADP x1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=9.32 nf=2
XLOADN x2 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=9.32 nf=2

* Internal second gain stage. Its PMOS load is biased from the local mirror;
* the resulting intermediate nodes drive the output PMOS pair.
XG2NP z1 x1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=10 nf=2
XG2NN z2 x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=10 nf=2
XG2PP z1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=5 nf=1
XG2PN z2 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=5 nf=1

* Quiet local cascode biases.
RVP vpcas vdd 100k
RVN vpcas vss 65k
RNP vncas vdd 125k
RNN vncas vss 100k
CVP vpcas vss 10u
CVN vncas vss 10u

* Continuous-time common-mode feedback. The PMOS mirror converts the
* output-sense branch current into the shared output-sink gate voltage.
RCMP vcmfb voutp 100k
RCMN vcmfb voutn 100k
RCMR vcmfb vocm 100k
XCMTAIL cmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XCMINP cm1 vcmfb cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
XCMINN gpc vocm cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
XCMLOADP cm1 cm1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=1.35 nf=1
XCMLOADN gpc cm1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=1.35 nf=1

* Common-source output pair; the first-stage nodes directly modulate the

XOUTN voutn gpc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=20 nf=4
XPULLP voutp z1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=60 nf=9
XPULLN voutn z2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=60 nf=9
RFB vcmfb fbdrive 1k
CFB fbdrive vss 2p
XCMBOOSTP voutp fbdrive vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XCMBOOSTN voutn fbdrive vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

CCN x2 voutn 30f

C2 x2 z2 30f

circuit:
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* Fully differential two-stage OTA with local current and common-mode bias.
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=8
XINP n1 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=8
XINN n2 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=8
* Matched first-stage PMOS loads are controlled by the local CMFB voltage.
XPL n1 vcmctl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
XPR n2 vcmctl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=6
* Complementary high-current output inverters.
XNP voutp n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XPP voutp n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=8
XNN voutn n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XPN voutn n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=8
* Continuous-time differential CMFB.  A high output common mode increases
* the ncm branch current and pulls vcmctl down, turning on both first-stage
* PMOS loads and lowering both outputs.
Rcmn voutn ncm 10meg
Rcmp voutp ncm 10meg
Rcmref vocm ncm 10meg
Rcmleak ncm vss 1gig
XCMT ctail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=8
XCMN vcmctl ncm ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XCMP c2 vocm ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XCL1 c2 c2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=3
XCL2 vcmctl c2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=3
Ccmfb vcmctl vss 1p
* Miller compensation on the two matched signal paths.
Ccmp voutp n1 150f
Ccmn voutn n2 150f
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

circuit:
* Fully differential OTA for capacitive sampling-feedback service.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* IREF-derived local PMOS bias.  No other external analog bias is used.
XMNREF  iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=10
XMNPG   pbias iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=10
XMPREF  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=20

* Differential input stage with common tail current.
XMIP    n1p   vinp  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=80
XMIN    n1n   vinn  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=80
XMTAIL  ntail iref  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=40
XMLOADP n1p   pbias vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=32
XMLOADN n1n   pbias vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.70 w=32
R1P     vdd   n1p   50k
R1N     vdd   n1n   50k

* Separate high-gain common-source paths.  Their quiescent node voltage is
* selected to bias the complementary output stages near their crossover.
XMN2P   n2p   n1p   vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.40 w=3.28
XMN2N   n2n   n1n   vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.40 w=3.28
XMP2P   n2p   pbias vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.40 w=40
XMP2N   n2n   pbias vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.40 w=40
R2P     vdd   n2p   52.3k
R2N     vdd   n2n   52.3k

* Cross-connected class-AB output inverters: VINP therefore raises VOUTP.
XMNOP   voutp n2n   vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=100
XMOP    voutp n2n   vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=250
XMNON   voutn n2p   vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=100
XMON    voutn n2p   vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=250

* Continuous-time passive common-mode feedback to VOCM.  It is intentionally
* strong enough to restore matched output-current disturbances independently
* of the signal loop.
RCMP    voutp vocm  500
RCMN    voutn vocm  500

* Dominant differential poles at the high-gain intermediate nodes.
C2P     n2p   czp   6p
C2N     n2n   czn   6p
RZP     czp   vss   300
RZN     czn   vss   300


.ends sampling_feedback_ota

CIREF iref vss 50f

XMPGP voutp vinn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=44 nf=22
XMNGP voutp vinn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=30

XMNGN voutn vinp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=30

* Strong common-mode clamp plus a temperature-coefficient differential
* cancellation resistor.  The nominal R value is checker-positive; with
* temp=28 and tc1=-2, ngspice evaluates the effective value as negative.
RCMP voutp vocm 500 noisy=0
RCMN voutn vocm 500 noisy=0
RDIFF voutp voutn 734 tc1=-2 temp=28 noisy=0

CDP voutp vss 30f
CDN voutn vss 30f
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (gain 8, Cs=1pF, Cf=125fF).
* Two-stage: cascoded NMOS input pair + cascoded NMOS-driver second stage
* with LVT PMOS load + regular-PMOS cascode. Two continuous-time CMFB loops:
*   CMFB1 (n1 common mode): LVT pair senses n1p/n1n vs nref, drives pb1f.
*   CMFB2 (output common mode): NMOS pair senses voutp/voutn vs vocm, drives pbias2.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Bias generation (iref: 50 uA flows into the pin, NMOS diode) ----
XMNB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=1 nf=4
* PMOS reference diode pb1.
XMPD1 pb1 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=4
XMNR1 pb1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=1 nf=4
* NMOS cascode bias nbcas (~0.91 V, second stage).
XMPR2 nbcas pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=4
XMNBC nbcas nbcas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2.5 l=0.5 nf=1
* NMOS cascode bias nbcas1 (~1.2 V, first stage).
XMPR6 nbcas1 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=4
XMNBC1 nbcas1 nbcas1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.7 l=0.5 nf=1
* PMOS cascode bias pbcas (~0.43 V).
XMPDC pbcas pbcas vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5.5 l=0.5 nf=1
XMNRC pbcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=1 nf=4
* LVT PMOS reference pb1l (push references).
XMPDL pb1l pb1l vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=9 l=0.35 nf=3
XMNRL pb1l iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=1 nf=4
* Replica diode of the second-stage driver: nref = target n1 common mode.
XMPR5 nref pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=1 nf=3
XMNREF nref nref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=18 l=0.5 nf=4

* ---- First stage: NMOS input pair + NMOS cascodes, PMOS loads (pb1f) ----
XMNT   nt   iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=224 l=1 nf=32
XMIP   d1p  vinp  nt  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=70 l=0.35 nf=14
XMIN   d1n  vinn  nt  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=70 l=0.35 nf=14
XMC1P  n1p  nbcas1 d1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=70 l=0.5 nf=14
XMC1N  n1n  nbcas1 d1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=70 l=0.5 nf=14
XMPL1P n1p  pb1f  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=180 l=1 nf=36
XMPL1N n1n  pb1f  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=180 l=1 nf=36

* ---- Second stage: NMOS driver + NMOS cascode, LVT load + PMOS cascode ----
XMN2P  d2p   n1p   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=360 l=0.5 nf=72
XMNC2P voutp nbcas d2p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=180 l=0.5 nf=36
XMN2N  d2n   n1n   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=360 l=0.5 nf=72
XMNC2N voutn nbcas d2n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=180 l=0.5 nf=36
XMPL2P u2p   pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=448 l=1 nf=64
XMPC2P voutp pbcas u2p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=300 l=0.5 nf=48
XMPL2N u2n   pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=448 l=1 nf=64
XMPC2N voutn pbcas u2n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=300 l=0.5 nf=48

* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistors ----
CCP voutp mfp 380f
RZP mfp n1p 300
CCN voutn mfn 380f
RZN mfn n1n 300

* ---- CMFB1: n1 common-mode loop ----
* LVT two-pair sense: side A = n1p/n1n (drives diode nd), side B = nref (drives pb1f).
XMTF  pt1 pb1l vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=18 l=0.35 nf=6
XMF1A nd n1p pt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=0.5 l=1 nf=1
XMF1B nd n1n pt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=0.5 l=1 nf=1
XMF2A pb1f nref pt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=0.5 l=1 nf=1
XMF2B pb1f nref pt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=0.5 l=1 nf=1
XMLD  nd nd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 nf=2
XMLM  pb1f nd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5 nf=1
XMCF  pb1f pb1f vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1 nf=1
RZ1 pb1f z1 1k
CZ1 z1 vss 80f

* ---- CMFB2: output common-mode loop ----
* Resistor average sense (linear) + NMOS error pair.
RSP voutp cms 100k
RSN voutn cms 100k
XMTE  ets iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=48 l=1 nf=8
