taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage OTA for sampling-feedback load (gain 8).
* Stage 1: NMOS input pair + folded cascode (high DC gain for output range).
* Stage 2: PMOS common-source with NMOS current-source loads.
* Miller compensation with nulling resistors.
* CMFB1 (slow): PMOS DDA error amplifier trims first-stage bottom sinks so
*   that first-stage output CM tracks a diode replica of the stage-2 input.
* CMFB2 (fast): 5T error amplifier senses output CM via resistors and drives
*   the second-stage NMOS load gates.
* Only external bias port is iref (50 uA into an NMOS diode).
* All PMOS bias voltages are generated by series NMOS/PMOS-diode branches so
* PMOS currents track the NMOS reference over corners.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- reference diode ----------------
XMNR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1

* ---------------- stage 1: folded cascode ----------------
XM0 nsrc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=125 l=1 nf=4
XM1A n1xa vinp nsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=90 l=0.6 nf=5
XM1B n1xb vinn nsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=90 l=0.6 nf=5
XMP3PA n1xa pb3f vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=384 l=3 nf=4
XMP3PB n1xb pb3f vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=384 l=3 nf=4
* PMOS folding cascodes, gates grounded (Vth_p ~ 1 V, always on)
XMCPA n1a vss n1xa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.6 nf=5
XMCPB n1b vss n1xb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.6 nf=5
XM3NCA n1a ncasc2 nca vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=72 l=0.75 nf=6
XM3NA nca iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=73 l=3 nf=2
XM3NCB n1b ncasc2 ncb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=72 l=0.75 nf=6
XM3NB ncb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=73 l=3 nf=2
* CMFB1 trim sinks
XM3NTA ncta vc1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=45 l=3 nf=2
XM3NTCA n1a ncasc2 ncta vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=24 l=1.5 nf=2
XM3NTB nctb vc1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=45 l=3 nf=2
XM3NTCB n1b ncasc2 nctb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=24 l=1.5 nf=2
* startup aids (negligible leakage)
RSTART1 n1a vss 1G
RSTART2 n1b vss 1G
RUP1 vdd voutp 1G
RUP2 vdd voutn 1G

* ---------------- stage 2: PMOS common source ----------------
XM5A voutp n1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=250 l=0.5 nf=8
XM5B voutn n1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=250 l=0.5 nf=8
XM6A voutp vbias6 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=150 l=1 nf=4
XM6B voutn vbias6 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=150 l=1 nf=4
CCP voutp rza 0.5p
RZA rza n1a 150
CCN voutn rzb 0.5p
RZB rzb n1b 150

* ---------------- CMFB1: PMOS DDA error amp (slow) ----------------
XMDT1 ds1 pbiasg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=48 l=1 nf=2
XMDA1 dnx n1a ds1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=14 l=0.5 nf=2
XMDB1 vc1 vrep ds1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=0.5 nf=2
XMDT2 ds2 pbiasg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=48 l=1 nf=2
XMDA2 dnx n1b ds2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=14 l=0.5 nf=2
XMDB2 vc1 vrep ds2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=0.5 nf=2
* NMOS diode + mirror subtracts the n1-side current from the vrep-side
XMNDM dnx dnx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=2
XMNDM2 vc1 dnx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=2
* gain-setting diode keeps the error-amp output resistance low
XMNDX vc1 vc1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=15 l=1 nf=2
RSTART3 vc1 vdd 1G

* ---------------- CMFB2: 5T error amp (fast) ----------------
RSA voutp cm2 20k
RSB voutn cm2 20k
XMEA dea cm2 es vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 nf=2
XMEB vbias6 vocm es vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 nf=2
XMET es iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=2
XMPEA dea dea vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1
XMPEB vbias6 dea vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.5 nf=1
* fast common-mode feedforward path around stage 2
CFF2 cm2 vbias6 0.3p
* slow-path compensation for the DC common-mode accuracy loop
CVB6 vbias6 vss 130p

* ---------------- internal bias generation ----------------
* pb3f: stage-1 top PMOS current-source bias (tracking: series NMOS sink)
XMNB1 pb3f iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=1 nf=1
XMPB1 pb3f pb3f vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=18 l=3 nf=1
* pbiasg: general PMOS mirror bias (tracking)
XMNB3 pbiasg iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=1 nf=1
XMPB3 pbiasg pbiasg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1
* ncasc2: NMOS cascode gate bias (Vth + 2 Vov)
XMPB4 ncasc2 pbiasg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1
XMNB4 ncasc2 ncasc2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=1 nf=1
* vrep: replica of second-stage input bias (target for n1 common mode)
XMNB5 vrep iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=12.5 l=1 nf=1
XMP5R vrep vrep vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=15.6 l=0.5 nf=1

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage OTA with continuous-time common-mode feedback.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* Reference replication: the external 50 uA current sets both bias polarities.
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5
XMNPB pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5
XMPB pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10

* Level-shifted NMOS cascode reference.
XMPNC ncasc pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10
RCB ncasc ncased 6k
XMNCASB ncased ncased vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5

* Cascoded, high-gain differential input stage.
XMNTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60
XMNINN dn vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100
XMNINP dp vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100
XMNCAN fn ncasc dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160
XMNCAP fp ncasc dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160
XMPLN ptopn pfctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=44
XMPLP ptopp pfctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=44
XMPCN fn pbias ptopn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=500
XMPCP fp pbias ptopp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=500

* Slow first-stage common-mode servo; output CM has the fast correction path.
RFCMSENSP fp fcm 1meg
RFCMSENSN fn fcm 1meg
XMFCMTAIL fcmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10
XMFCM1 fpcm fcm fcmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XMFCM2 pfctrl fcref fcmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
RFREFP vocm fcref 10k
RFREFN fcref vss 80k
XMFCMP1 fpcm fpcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
XMFCMP2 pfctrl fpcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
CFSLOW pfctrl vdd 5n

* Degenerated cross-coupled pair raises differential gain without a noisy gain stage.
XNEGN fn fp negsn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1
XNEGP fp fn negsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1
RNEGN negsn vss 250k
RNEGP negsp vss 250k

* High-swing common-source output stage.
XMNOUTN voutn fn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120
XMNOUTP voutp fp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120
XMPOUTN voutn pctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=640
XMPOUTP voutp pctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=640

* Differential Miller compensation with lead resistors.
CCMN fn cmilln 500f
RCMN cmilln voutn 300
CCMP fp cmillp 500f
RCMP cmillp voutp 300

* Resistive output averaging and a continuous-time CM error amplifier.
RCMSENSP voutp vcm 20k
RCMSENSN voutn vcm 20k
XMCMTAIL cmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20
XMCM1 pcm vcm cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
XMCM2 pctrl vocm cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
XMCMP1 pcm pcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
XMCMP2 pctrl pcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
CCMFF vcm pctrl 20f

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage OTA with continuous-time common-mode feedback.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* The external 50 uA reference sets all internal bias branches.
XNR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XNTAIL ntail ntb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=320 nf=4
XNCMTAIL cmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMPNT ntb pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMNNT ntb ntb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XMPFR nfref pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMNFR nfref nfref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2

* Cascoded, current-source-loaded differential input stage.  The resistors
* carry the small branch-current difference and help establish dp/dn.
XMIP fdp vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=80 nf=4
XMIN fdn vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=80 nf=4
XMNFCP dp nbcf fdp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XMNFCN dn nbcf fdn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
RDP vdd dp 124k
RDN vdd dn 124k

* First-stage PMOS loads are continuously servoed to the required current.
XMPFDP pfdp pfctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=380 nf=4
XMPFDN pfdn pfctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=380 nf=4
XMPFCP dp pbc pfdp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=240 nf=4
XMPFCN dn pbc pfdn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=240 nf=4
XMPNF nbcf pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMNBF nbf nbf vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
RNBF nbcf nbf 7k

* First-stage common-mode feedback regulates dp/dn to the internal nfref
* reference.  Small compensation capacitors are differentially benign.
RFCMSP dp fcm 1meg
RFCMSN dn fcm 1meg
CFCMSP dp fcm 20f
CFCMSN dn fcm 20f
XNCFT fcmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNFCS fcdd fcm fcmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=5 nf=1
XNFCR pfctrl nfref fcmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=5 nf=1
XNFCD fcdd fcdd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNFCP pfctrl fcdd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
CFCFP dp pfctrl 20f
CFCFN dn pfctrl 20f
CPFCTRL pfctrl vdd 50p
CFCM fcm nfref 20p

* Replica-biased high-swing output cascodes.  The resistor in the NMOS
* bias branch provides the source-level headroom needed by the cascode.
XMPBC pbc pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMNBCR pbc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XMPNB nbc pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMNBD nbd nbd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
RNB nbc nbd 2.8k
XMPBO pbo pbo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XMNBOR pbo iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

* Cascoded class-A output stages combine high DC gain with rail-to-rail
* differential excursion around the 0.9 V output common mode.
XMOP nsp dp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=4
XMON nsn dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=4
XMNCP voutp nbc nsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=120 nf=4
XMNCN voutn nbc nsn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=120 nf=4
XMPCP psp pctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=800 nf=4
XMPCN psn pctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=800 nf=4
XMPCCP voutp pbo psp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=600 nf=4
XMPCCN voutn pbo psn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=600 nf=4

* Differential Miller compensation, including series zero-nulling resistors.
CCP dp ncp 550f
CCN dn ncn 550f
RCP ncp voutp 1.5k
RCN ncn voutn 1.5k

* High-impedance resistive averaging sets the DC common-mode sense level;
* small parallel capacitors maintain sensing bandwidth during fast events.
RCMSP voutp cms 1meg
RCMSN voutn cms 1meg
CCMSP voutp cms 20f
CCMSN voutn cms 20f

* A five-transistor CM error amplifier controls both PMOS output sources.
XMCMS cmdd cms cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=10 nf=2
XMCMR pctrl vocm cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=10 nf=2
XMCMD cmdd cmdd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMCMP pctrl cmdd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* Common-mode Miller compensation also gives fast, correctly phased
* feedforward when equal current pulses disturb both outputs.
CCMFP voutp pctrl 300f

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller OTA with continuous-time CMFB.
* Two-stage: NMOS diff pair (LVT) + PMOS loads → PMOS CS + NMOS loads.
* Internal CMFB via resistive sensing and NMOS error amplifier.
*
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ── Bias chain ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
* NMOS diode: sets iref from 50uA IREF
XMb0       iref      iref      vss       vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=4.0  nf=2
* Startup: ensure iref is biased even if Mb0 initially off
Rstrt_iref iref      vss                  1M

* NMOS tail mirror: ~50uA tail current
XMtail     tailn     iref      vss       vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=4.0  nf=2

* PMOS bias: NMOS mirror sinks from PMOS diode to set pb_int
XMmp       pb_int    iref      vss       vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=4.0  nf=2
XMp0       pb_int    pb_int    vdd       vdd       sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=8.0  nf=2
* Startup: ensure pb_int has path to VDD
Rstrt_pb   vdd       pb_int              1M

* ── First stage: NMOS diff pair (LVT) + PMOS loads ────────────────
XM1        n1        vinp      tailn     vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=8.0  nf=2
XM2        n2        vinn      tailn     vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=8.0  nf=2

* PMOS loads: standard pfet (|Vth|≈0.95V), W/L=8, L=1u for high ro
XM3        n1        pb_int    vdd       vdd       sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1.0  w=4.0  nf=2
XM4        n2        pb_int    vdd       vdd       sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1.0  w=4.0  nf=2

* ── Second stage: PMOS CS + NMOS loads ─────────────────────────────
* L=2u for high output resistance
XM5        voutn     n2        vdd       vdd       sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=2.0  w=8.0  nf=4
XM6        voutp     n1        vdd       vdd       sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=2.0  w=8.0  nf=4
XM7        voutn     cmfb_out  vss       vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=2.0  w=8.0  nf=4
XM8        voutp     cmfb_out  vss       vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=2.0  w=8.0  nf=4

* ── Continuous-time CMFB ──────────────────────────────────────────
Rcmfb1     voutp     cmfb_node           100k
Rcmfb2     voutn     cmfb_node           100k

* CMFB error amplifier: low tail current so PMOS loads stay on
*   Tail: L=2.5u → W/L=1.6 → I_tail ≈ 10uA (5uA per arm)
XM_cm_tail cmfb_tail iref      vss       vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=2.5  w=4.0  nf=2
*   Diff pair
XM_cm1     n_cm1     cmfb_node cmfb_tail vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=4.0  nf=2
XM_cm2     cmfb_out  vocm      cmfb_tail vss       sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=4.0  nf=2
*   PMOS active loads: W/L=16 so they can source 5uA with Vsg > |Vthp|
XM_cm3     n_cm1     n_cm1     vdd       vdd       sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=8.0  nf=2
XM_cm4     cmfb_out  n_cm1     vdd       vdd       sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=8.0  nf=2
*   Compensation
Ccmfb      cmfb_out  vss                  10p

* ── Miller compensation (cross-coupled) ───────────────────────────
Cc1        n1        voutp                640f
Cc2        n2        voutn                640f

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage OTA with continuous-time common-mode feedback.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* The external 50 uA reference sets the input- and CM-error-amplifier tails.
XNBREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XNTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=20
XNCTAIL nctail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XNBP nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMPBP nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11 nf=1
XMPBC nbcas dcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XNBC nbcas nbcas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMPBIC nbincas dcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XNBIC nbincas nbincas nsic vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
RNSIC nsic vss 5k
XNDREF dref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8
XMPDREF dref dref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=150 nf=15
CDREF dref vss 1p
XNFTAIL nftail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4

* Cascoded differential input stage with actively biased PMOS loads.
XNINP ip vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=50 nf=10
XNINN in vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=50 nf=10
XNICP dp nbincas ip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
XNICN dn nbincas in vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
XMPLP dp pfctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
XMPLN dn pfctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10

* The slow first-stage CM loop uses a constant-current driver replica as its reference.
RFBP dp davg 100meg
RFBN dn davg 100meg
CSFBP dp davg 20f
CSFBN dn davg 20f
CDAVG davg vss 20f
XNFCP dfc davg nftail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNFCN pfctrl dref nftail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMPFCP dfc dfc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMPFCN pfctrl dfc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RZFC1 pfctrl pfcp 1
RZFC2 pfctrl pfcn 1
CFBF1 pfcp dp 100f
CFBF2 pfcn dn 100f
CPFCTRL pfctrl vdd 200p

* Cascoded high-gain, wide-swing PMOS common-source output stage.
XMPDRIVP psp dp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=150 nf=15
XMPDRIVN psn dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=150 nf=15
XMPCASP voutp nbp psp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=400 nf=20
XMPCASN voutn nbp psn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=400 nf=20
XMNCASP voutp nbcas nsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=100 nf=10
XMNCASN voutn nbcas nsn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=100 nf=10
XMNSINKP nsp cmctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=150 nf=15
XMNSINKN nsn cmctrl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=150 nf=15

* Differential Miller compensation with zero-nulling resistors.
RZP dp cpp 700
RZN dn cpn 700
CCMP cpp voutp 1p
CCMN cpn voutn 1p

* Resistive common-mode sensing and a continuous-time error amplifier.
RCMP voutp cms 100meg
RCMN voutn cms 100meg
CSENSP voutp cms 20f
CSENSN voutn cms 20f
CCMS cms vss 20f
XNCM1 dcm cms nctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XNCM2 cmctrl vocm nctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMPMC1 dcm dcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMPMC2 cmctrl dcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* Common-mode Miller compensation; these capacitors also localize load steps.

RZCM2 cmctrl cmcn 1

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Two-stage: diff pair + CS output, Miller compensated, internal CMFB
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* === Bias Generation ===
XM_BN iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XM_BP_D nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XM_BP_M nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2

* === First Stage: Differential Pair + PMOS Mirror Load ===
* NMOS tail (~700uA: mirror ratio 14:1 from 50uA ref)
XM_TAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=28

* Input NMOS pair (~350uA each)
XM1 n1 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=10
XM2 n2 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=10

* PMOS current mirror load (~350uA each side)
XM3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=7
XM4 n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=7

* === Second Stage: CS Output Drivers ===
* NMOS drivers (gate: n1->voutn, n2->voutp for non-inverting response)
XM5 voutp n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=8
XM7 voutn n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=8

* PMOS loads controlled by CMFB
XM8 voutp ncmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=15
XM10 voutn ncmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=15

* === Miller Compensation ===
CC1 n2 voutp 2p
CC2 n1 voutn 2p

* === CMFB Network ===
R_CM1 voutp ncmfb_s 20k
R_CM2 voutn ncmfb_s 20k

* CMFB error amplifier
XM_CA ncmfb_a ncmfb_s ntail_cm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XM_CB ncmfb_b vocm ntail_cm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XM_CT ntail_cm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2

* CMFB PMOS mirror load
XM_CC1 ncmfb_a ncmfb_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XM_CC2 ncmfb ncmfb_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* CMFB pull-down current sink
XM_CPD ncmfb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA
* Stage 1: NMOS-pair folded cascode (high gain)
* Stage 2: NMOS CS + LVT-PMOS current-source load
* Miller Cc, continuous-time resistive CMFB, internal bias from iref
* All PMOS are LVT (|Vth|~0.43V) for usable headroom in 1.8V.
* I_PS set by current mirror from XNMIR/XPDIODE (geometry, not KCL luck).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ================= BIAS =================
XNREF   iref  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2

* PMOS bias VBP: NMOS sink + LVT PMOS diode (master of the fold mirror)
XNMIR   vbp   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=42 nf=4
XPDIODE vbp   vbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=5

* NMOS cascode bias VBN_CAS
XNCD    vbn_cas vbn_cas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.5 nf=1
XPCB    vbn_cas vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4

* PMOS cascode bias VBP_CAS = VBP - I*R
XNCSBP  vbp_cas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
RCBP    vbp vbp_cas 6.7k

* ================= STAGE 1: folded cascode =================
* LVT PMOS fold current sources (1:1 mirror from XPDIODE)
XPS1    foldp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=5
XPS2    foldn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=5

* LVT PMOS cascodes  (bulk=source)
XPC1    v1p vbp_cas foldp foldp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30 nf=3
XPC2    v1n vbp_cas foldn foldn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30 nf=3

* NMOS cascode loads + current sources
XNC1    v1p vbn_cas xn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XNC2    v1n vbn_cas xn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XNS1    xn1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XNS2    xn2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2

* NMOS input pair
XINA    foldn vinp xtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=45 nf=9
XINB    foldp vinn xtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=45 nf=9
XTAIL   xtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4

* ================= STAGE 2: NMOS CS + LVT PMOS load =================
X2P     voutp v1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
X2N     voutn v1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
XPP1    voutp vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=5
XPP2    voutn vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=5

* ================= MILLER COMPENSATION =================
CCP     v1n voutp 100f
CCN     v1p voutn 100f

* ================= CMFB =================
RSENSP  voutp vcms 80k
RSENSN  voutn vcms 80k

XCMI1   xcm1  vcms xct   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XCMI2   vcmfb vocm xct   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XCMT    xct   iref vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XCMP1   xcm1  xcm1 vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4
XCMP2   vcmfb xcm1 vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4

CCM     vcmfb xcm1 20f

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (SKY130)
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ===================== Bias =====================
* NMOS diode sinks external 50uA from iref
XMBN  iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2

* PMOS bias diode (w=20 l=0.5 => Vsg~1.13V @50uA, vbiasp~0.67V)
XNPM  vbiasp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XPPM  vbiasp vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10

* NMOS cascode gate bias: resistor divider ~1.30V
* (cascode on for n1<0.60V; in saturation for v1p>0.60V)
RBC1  vdd    vbiasncas 50k
RBC2  vbiasncas vss   130k
CBC   vbiasncas vss   1p

* ===================== Stage 1: folded cascode =====================
* NMOS LVT input pair (100uA per side)
XM1   n1 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=8
XM2   n2 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=8
XTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4

* Fold PMOS current sources
XMPS1 n1 vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=320 nf=40
XMPS2 n2 vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=320 nf=40

* Anti-latch bleeders: diode-connected NMOS conducts only when n1/n2
* rise above ~0.7V (cascode-off failure mode), invisible at normal OP.
XDB1 n1 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1
XDB2 n2 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1

* NMOS cascodes (signal path)
XCAS1 v1p vbiasncas n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=32
XCAS2 v1n vbiasncas n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=32

* Stage-1 output current sinks (slow CMFB drives ncmfb)
XMNa  v1p ncmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=20
XMNb  v1n ncmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=20

* ===================== Stage 2: class-AB inverters =====================
* PMOS W/L=280 vs NMOS W/L=20 balances drive strengths
XMOP  voutp v1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=280 nf=40
XMON  voutp v1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=10
XMOPN voutn v1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=280 nf=40
XMONN voutn v1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=10

* ===================== Miller compensation with Rz zero =====================
RZP voutp vcmp 400
CCP vcmp v1p 250f
RZN voutn vcmn 400
CCN vcmn v1n 250f

* ===================== Fast CMFB injectors =====================
RS1 voutp vsense 10k
RS2 voutn vsense 10k

XINJ1 voutp vsense vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XINJ2 voutn vsense vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* ===================== Slow CMFB amp =====================
* vsense on output side, vocm on diode side: ncmfb falls when vsense rises
XMCFB1 ncfb1 vocm  ntailc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XMCFB2 ncmfb vsense ntailc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XTAILC ntailc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMCFB3 ncfb1 ncfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10
XMCFB4 ncmfb ncfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10
CCMFB ncmfb ncfb1 100f

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA.
* The feedback network (Cs=1pF, Cf=125fF) and CL=250fF loads are
* provided by the testbench; this subcircuit implements the OTA core,
* all bias generation from iref, and continuous-time output CM feedback.
* Interface: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias reference: the testbench drives 50 uA into iref from VDD, which
* the diode-connected device below sinks, establishing Vbn (iref node).
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
* VBP: PMOS reference carrying a mirrored copy of iref; tracks VDD so the
* PMOS current-keeper loads keep constant |Vsg| (positive-rail rejection).
XMPB vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMNBP vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 1: NMOS input pair (vinp on M1, vinn on M2), PMOS current-mirror
* load, NMOS tail current source.  Inverting: vinp up pulls n1 down.
XMT1 tn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=360 nf=9
XM1 n1 vinp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
XM2 n2 vinn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=1
XMP3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMP4 n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 2: per-output common-source NMOS driver with PMOS current-source
* load (gate VBP tracks VDD).  Inverting, so the OTA is non-inverting
* from vinp to voutp.  Output swings close to both rails.
XM6 voutp n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=4
XM8 voutn n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=4
XMP7 voutp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMP9 voutn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Continuous-time output common-mode feedback.
* Sense output CM with ideal resistors.
RC1 voutp cms 200k
RC2 voutn cms 200k
* Error amplifier: PMOS input pair (cms vs vocm), PMOS current-source
* tail (gate VBP), NMOS mirror load.  Vc=ead2 is non-inverting in cms:
* CM up -> Vc up -> CMFB shunts pull CM down.
XMTe eadc vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMP10 ead1 cms eadc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMP11 ead2 vocm eadc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMD1 ead1 ead1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMD2 ead2 ead1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* Bidirectional CMFB shunts at the outputs (common gate Vc=ead2):
* Vc up -> NMOS sinks more, PMOS sources less -> CM down; Vc down -> CM up.
XMSNP voutp ead2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMSPP voutp ead2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMSNN voutn ead2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMSPN voutn ead2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA.
* Interface: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* iref is the only external bias port (50 uA reference). All internal bias
* voltages and continuous-time output common-mode feedback are generated inside.
* Devices: sky130 MOS wrappers and ideal R/C only.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Bias: iref -> NMOS diode (clean startup). PMOS rail bp from a
* cross-coupled PMOS/NMOS diode pair. All mirror currents ratioed to 50 uA.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XNIREF  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XPBP    bp bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XNBPI   bp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=1
* Stage 1 tail current source (NMOS, gate on iref rail)
XMT1    st1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=484 nf=1
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Stage 1: NMOS differential input pair, PMOS current-mirror load.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XM1   xp vinp st1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=560 nf=1
XM2   xn vinn st1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=560 nf=1
XM3   xp xp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=62 nf=1
XM4   xn xp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=62 nf=1
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source drivers, PMOS current-source loads.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XM5   outp xp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=121 nf=1
XM6   outn xn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=121 nf=1
XP5   outp bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=78 nf=1
XP6   outn bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=78 nf=1
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* CMFB error amplifier (inverting): e1 moves down when cmn moves up.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XE1   e1 cmn etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XE2   e2 vocm etail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XET   etail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=387 nf=1
XL1   e1 bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XL2   e2 bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Inverter: non-inverting CMFB drive e1b from e1.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XPINV e1b e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XNINV e1b e1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Direct output CM injection: common gate e1b, small idle current
* (high output resistance for differential signals).
* MPinj sources less / MNinj sinks more when e1b rises.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XMP1  outp e1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP2  outn e1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN1  outp e1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XMN2  outn e1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Miller compensation
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
CC1   outp xp 400f
CC2   outn xn 400f
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Output common-mode sense (ideal resistors, no DC bias current)
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
RCM1  voutp cmn 100k
RCM2  voutn cmn 100k
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA (opamp core).
* External analog bias: iref only (50 uA). All internal bias voltages and
* continuous-time output common-mode feedback are generated inside the DUT.
* Approved elements only: sky130 MOS X-subcircuits and ideal R/C.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- Bias reference from iref ----------------
X1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1   ; NMOS bias gate (~0.71 V)
X3 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1   ; vbp generator sink
X4 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1   ; vbp generator source

* ---------------- Stage 1: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load, NFET tail ----------------
X5 p1p vinp it1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=1
X6 p1n vinn it1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=1
X7 it1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=1  ; NFET tail
X8 p1p p1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=1    ; diode load
X9 p1n p1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=1    ; mirror load

* ---------------- Stage 2: PMOS CS pair, NMOS current-source load ----------------
X10 voutp p1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=1
X11 voutn p1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=1
X12 voutp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=1 ; load voutp
X13 voutn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=1 ; load voutn

* ---------------- Continuous-time CMFB ----------------
R1 voutp cmin 200k
R2 voutn cmin 200k
X15 d1 cmin it2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1   ; input cmin
X16 d2 vocm it2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1   ; input vocm
X17 it2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=1   ; NFET tail
X18 d1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1   ; PMOS pull-up load d1
X19 d2 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1   ; PMOS pull-up load d2
X20 vcmfb d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1   ; inverter d1->vcmfb
X21 vcmfb d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1
X22 voutp vcmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1 ; CMFB sink p
X23 voutn vcmfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1 ; CMFB sink n

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
Cc1 p1p rz1 400f
Rz1 rz1 voutp 4000
Cc2 p1n rz2 400f
Rz2 rz2 voutn 4000
.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA in SKY130.
* Architecture:
*  - Stage 1: NMOS-input folded cascode.
*  - Stage 2: class-A complementary common-source output stage.
*  - Miller compensation from each output to its driving first-stage node.
*  - All bias generated internally from iref (50 uA sunk from vdd).
*  - Local CMFB servos the first-stage output common mode by trimming the
*    fold current-source gates (level-shifted follower driver).
*  - Global continuous-time CMFB: R/C average of the outputs compared with
*    vocm, driving push-pull correction devices at both outputs.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* iref pin sinks 50 uA; diode-connected reference sets the NMOS gate bias.
XREFN iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
* PMOS gate bias: NMOS mirror sinks 50 uA from an LVT PMOS diode.
XMNM1 pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XMPD pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5 nf=2
* NMOS cascode bias (~1.2 V): narrow diode fed by a PMOS mirror.
XMPM1 ncas pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5 nf=2
XMNC ncas ncas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.76 nf=1
* PMOS cascode bias (vdd - ~0.85 V): narrow LVT PMOS diode.
XMNM2 pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XMPC pcas pcas vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=0.65 nf=1
* Gate bias for the tail current source (~1.0 V).
XT2A nt1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5 nf=2
XT2B nt1 nt1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.2 nf=1

* ---------------- first stage: folded cascode ----------------
* Tail current source, 400 uA, long channel for output resistance.
XT1 tail nt1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=45 nf=7
* Input pair, split two ways per side for mismatch averaging.
X1AP fold_p vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=6
X1BP fold_p vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=6
X1AN fold_n vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=6
X1BN fold_n vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=6
* PMOS fold current sources, gates driven by the local CMFB (pb2).
XFPp fold_p pbd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=37 nf=12
XFPn fold_n pbd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=37 nf=12
* PMOS common-gate cascodes, 150 uA per side.
XFCp vop1 pcas fold_p fold_p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=58 nf=15
XFCn von1 pcas fold_n fold_n sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=58 nf=15
* NMOS cascode loads, 150 uA per side.
XNCp vop1 ncas nlsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=6
XNL1p nlsp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=6
XNCn von1 ncas nlsn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=6
XNL1n nlsn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=6

* ---------------- local CMFB: first-stage output CM ----------------
* Sense avg(vop1,von1), compare with vdd/2, and steer the fold current by
* sinking the fold reference diode XFPD. The fold devices mirror XFPD 2x,
* so total fold current = 2 * I(XERR). Sign: mid1 high -> XG1 off -> n1g
* low -> XERR off -> fold current down -> vop1 down (negative feedback).
RM1 vop1 mid1 300k
RM2 von1 mid1 300k
CMR1 vop1 mid1 200f
CMR2 von1 mid1 200f
RV1 vdd vref1 300k
RV2 vref1 vss 300k
XMTC1 ncm1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=2
XG1 n1g mid1 ncm1 ncm1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5 nf=2
XG2 n2g vref1 ncm1 ncm1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5 nf=2
XGL1 n1g n1g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XGL2 n2g n1g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
CNG n2g vss 100f
* Fold reference diode, starved by the error device XERR.
XFPD pbd pbd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=18.5 nf=6
XERR pbd n1g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* Miller compensation of the local loop; series R relocates the zero, two
* branches keep differential signals out of the CM error node.
RZA n1g n3a 750
RZB n1g n3b 750
CMLA n3a vop1 5p
CMLB n3b von1 5p


* ---------------- second stage: class-A output ----------------
* voutp driven from vop1, voutn driven from von1 (inverting stages).
X5NP voutp vop1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=45 nf=7
X5PP voutp vop1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=12 nf=6
X5NN voutn von1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=45 nf=7
X5PN voutn von1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=12 nf=6

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
CC1 voutp vop1 300f
CC2 voutn von1 300f

* ---------------- global CMFB ----------------
* Output average via resistive divider with feedforward caps for speed.
RD1 voutp mid 500k
RD2 voutn mid 500k
CFD1 voutp mid 300f
CFD2 voutn mid 300f
* Sense amplifier: LVT PMOS pair comparing mid with vocm, NMOS mirror load.
XMTC ncm pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=2
XS1A n1 vocm ncm ncm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5 nf=2
XS1B n1 vocm ncm ncm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5 nf=2
XS2A n2 mid ncm ncm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5 nf=2
XS2B n2 mid ncm ncm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5 nf=2
XSL1 n1 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XSL2 n2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
* Inverting driver stage.
XDRVp cdrv n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=4
XDRVn cdrv n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=7
* Miller compensation of the CMFB driver.
CM1 n2 cdrv 100f
* Push-pull output correction devices.
XCRN_p voutp cdrv vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XCRN_n voutn cdrv vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XCRP_p voutp cdrv vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=2
XCRP_n voutn cdrv vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=2

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential two-stage Miller OTA for Cs=8Cf sampling-feedback load.
* NMOS input pair (input CM 0.9 V), pfet_lvt cascoded current-source loads,
* cascoded second stage, Miller compensation. Continuous-time CMFB senses the
* output CM with resistors and drives small PMOS output CM sources through a
* two-stage non-inverting error amplifier (NMOS pair + pfet mirror, pfet CS).
* All bias derived from iref=50 uA: NMOS diode at iref -> viref; pfet_lvt
* master diode -> vbp; scaled replicas generate the PMOS cascode gates and
* the stage-1 NMOS load gate; dividers set the NMOS cascode gates.
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* iref NMOS diode, 50 uA: viref ~ 0.79
Xbn1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=9.5 nf=2
* master pfet_lvt diode, 50 uA: vbp ~ vdd-0.72 (vov ~ 0.25)
Xbd vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=27 nf=4
Xbds vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=9.5 nf=2
* tail-gate replica: pfet source into NMOS diode lifted by Rtl -> vbn_tail ~ 1.04
Xtlp vbn_tail vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=53 nf=8
Xtlnd vbn_tail vbn_tail vtl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=19 nf=3
Rtl vtl vss 2.5k
* stage-1 PMOS cascode-gate replica -> vbp_cas1
X4r n2r vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=43.2 nf=8
X4cr vbp_cas1 vbp_cas1 n2r vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=22.2 nf=4
Xb4s vbp_cas1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=7.5 nf=2
* stage-2 PMOS cascode-gate replica -> vbp_cas2
X6sr n6r vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=43.2 nf=8
X6cr vbp_cas2 vbp_cas2 n6r vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=22.2 nf=4
Xb6s vbp_cas2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=7.5 nf=2
* stage-1 NMOS load gate replica -> nb9 ~ 0.74
Xb9p nb9 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=43.2 nf=8
Xb9n nb9 nb9 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13.4 nf=2
* NMOS cascode-gate dividers (~0.95), bypassed
Rc1t vdd vbn_cas 85k
Rc1b vbn_cas vss 95k
Cb1 vbn_cas vss 20p
Rc2t vdd vbn_cas2 85k
Rc2b vbn_cas2 vss 95k
Cb2 vbn_cas2 vss 20p

* ---------------- tail current source (800 uA) ----------------
Xt1 tail vbn_tail vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=150 nf=24

* ---------------- stage 1: NMOS input pair, pfet_lvt cascoded loads ----------------
X1a a vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=96
X1b b vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=96
X4a n2a vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=432 nf=64
X4b n2b vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=432 nf=64
X4ca a vbp_cas1 n2a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=222 nf=32
X4cb b vbp_cas1 n2b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=222 nf=32
X3a a vbn_cas na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=134 nf=22
X3b b vbn_cas nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=134 nf=22
X9a na nb9 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=134 nf=22
X9b nb nb9 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=134 nf=22

* ---------------- stage 2: NMOS CS + cascode, pfet_lvt source + cascode ----------------
X5a n5a a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=267 nf=43
X5b n5b b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=267 nf=43
X5ca voutp vbn_cas2 n5a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=150 nf=24
X5cb voutn vbn_cas2 n5b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=150 nf=24
X6sa n6a vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=864 nf=128
X6sb n6b vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=864 nf=128
X6ca voutp vbp_cas2 n6a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=444 nf=64
X6cb voutn vbp_cas2 n6b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=444 nf=64

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
Rm1 a ma 50
Cm1 ma voutp 1p
Rm2 b mb 50
Cm2 mb voutn 1p

* ---------------- output CM sensing ----------------
Rs1 voutp cms 200k
Rs2 voutn cms 200k

* ---------------- CM error amplifier ----------------
* NMOS pair (cms vs vocm) + pfet mirror (x1 ~ 1.08), pfet CS output stage
* driving PMOS CM trim sources at the outputs: two inversions -> the loop is
* negative. Miller-compensated around the output stage.
Xct ct vbn_tail vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=75 nf=12
Xc1 xc1 vocm ct vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=48
Xc2 x1 cms ct vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=48
Xl1 xc1 xc1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=108 nf=16
Xl2 x1 xc1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=108 nf=16
Xc5p cmfb x1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=216 nf=32
Xcln cmfb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=75 nf=12
Rser x1 mcm 2.2k
Ccm mcm cmfb 1.2p
Rstart cmfb vbn_cas 2meg
* PMOS CM trim sources
Xsa voutp cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=43.4 nf=7
Xsb voutn cmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=43.4 nf=7

.ends sampling_feedback_ota

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential Sampling-Feedback OTA: Gain 8, 10 ns Settling, 1 mVrms Noise
circuit:
* Fully differential sampling-feedback OTA in SKY130.
* Architecture: telescopic first stage (LVT NMOS input pair, NMOS cascodes
* with fixed gates, PMOS cascode loads whose gates are set by gain-boost
* amplifiers that also define the d1/d2 DC level at vdd/2), NMOS
* common-source second stage, Miller compensation with series Rz,
* continuous-time resistive-sense CMFB driving PMOS common-mode injection
* devices. All biases generated from iref (50 uA).
.subckt sampling_feedback_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- bias ----
* iref diode: ~0.75 V (50 uA, Vov ~ 0.13)
XMBN iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* pbias ~ vdd-1.06 (PMOS diode sunk by iref-biased NMOS), 50 uA
XMBPO pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25 nf=5
XMBSN pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* pbias2 ~ vdd-1.23 (PMOS diode at larger Vov), 50 uA, mirror for XML1/2
XMBPO2 pbias2 pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.8 nf=2
XMBSN2 pbias2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* supply divider: taps at 0.75*vdd, 0.5*vdd, 0.25*vdd (50 uA at 1.8 V)
RD1 vdd div135 9k
RD2 div135 div09 9k
RD3 div09 div045 9k
RD4 div045 vss 9k

* First-stage output CM loop: senses (d1+d2)/2 via 10M resistors and
* drives the PMOS load gates pbiasl so that d1/d2 sit at vdd/2.
* (Differential impedance at d1/d2 stays that of the cascoded stage.)
RDC1 d1 dcm 10meg
RDC2 d2 dcm 10meg
XMBT1 bd1a dcm bt1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=7 nf=2
XMBT2 pbiasl div09 bt1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=7 nf=2
XMBTT1 bt1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XMBP1 bd1a bd1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25 nf=5
XMBP2 pbiasl bd1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25 nf=5
* Miller compensation of the first-stage CM loop
CMC pbiasl bd1a 1u

* --------------------------------------------------------- first stage ----
* Tail current source (600 uA)
XMTAIL t1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=24
* NMOS input pair (300 uA/side, Vov ~ 0.15)
XM1 s1c vinp t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=58.5 nf=13
XM2 s2c vinn t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=58.5 nf=13
* NMOS cascodes, gates fixed at 0.75*vdd
XM3 d1 div135 s1c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=44 nf=9
XM4 d2 div135 s2c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=44 nf=9
* PMOS loads (300 uA, gate pbiasl)
XM5 p1c pbiasl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=80
XM6 p2c pbiasl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=80
* PMOS cascodes, gates fixed at 0.25*vdd
XM7 d1 div045 p1c vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=80
XM8 d2 div045 p2c vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=80

* -------------------------------------------------- second stage ----------
* NMOS common-source amplifiers (gate d1/d2 ~ 0.9 V, ~1 mA)
XMS1 voutp d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=47 nf=10
XMS2 voutn d2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=47 nf=10
* PMOS current-source loads (~950 uA, Vov ~ 0.3)
XML1 voutp pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=13
XML2 voutn pbias2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=13

* Miller compensation with series zero resistor
RZ1 voutp nz1 420
CC1 nz1 d1 470f
RZ2 voutn nz2 420
CC2 nz2 d2 470f

* ------------------------------------------------------------- CMFB -------
* Output common-mode sense (resistive average)
RS1 voutp cms 10k
RS2 voutn cms 10k
* CMFB error amplifier: LVT NMOS pair (vocm vs cms), PMOS mirror load.
* Signal output is the mirror-output node cdb.
XMCA1 cda vocm cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=2
XMCA2 cdb cms cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=2
XMCT cmt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XMCP1 cda cda vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25 nf=5
XMCP2 cdb cda vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25 nf=5
* Second stage: NMOS common source driving CM injection gates,
* PMOS current-source load (300 uA).
XMD2 gcm cdb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=46 nf=10
XPLD gcm pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=300 nf=60
* Miller compensation of CMFB amp; series R places LHP zero at CM output pole
RCM gcm ncm 5.1k
CCM ncm cdb 1p
* PMOS common-mode injection devices (~450 uA/side quiescent)
XMCM1 voutp gcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=10
XMCM2 voutn gcm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=10

.ends sampling_feedback_ota
